plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Market

Public plugin index for the `weft-audit` DeepSeek Harness plugin family.

This repository is metadata-only. It contains no executable plugin code and no
credentials. The source of truth is [`plugin_index.json`](plugin_index.json);
each plugin remains owned and tested in its own repository.

## Plugins

| Plugin | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [`dsh-guardrail`](https://github.com/weft-audit/dsh-guardrail) | Hard safety checks plus soft gap hints |
| [`dsh-audit`](https://github.com/weft-audit/dsh-audit) | Fixed-rubric 0–10 scorer; scores only |
| [`dsh-ledger`](https://github.com/weft-audit/dsh-ledger) | Append-only usage ledger and reports |
| [`dsh-checkpoint`](https://github.com/weft-audit/dsh-checkpoint) | Checkpoint and resume protocol without automatic execution |
| [`dsh-judgement`](https://github.com/weft-audit/dsh-judgement) | Twenty-item judgement checklist skill |
| [`dsh-dod`](https://github.com/weft-audit/dsh-dod) | Evidence-first completion hints and report checker |

## Install

Install from a plugin repository according to the target DSH profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/weft-audit/dsh-guardrail
```

Replace the final repository name with the plugin you need. Follow that
plugin's README for tests, tool permissions, and known limitations.

## Index contract

- `format` identifies the index schema generation;
- every `versions[].source.commit` pins the published source revision;
- `engines.dsh` records the supported Harness range;
- plugin descriptions must not imply capabilities that are absent from the
  linked source repository.

## Validation

```powershell
$index = Get-Content .\plugin_index.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$index.plugins.Count
```

Expected count: `6`.

plugins.description: Keeps bulk output out of the conversation from both ends: a routing gate refuses flooding calls (curl/wget in any shell, web_fetch/read_page), and output already inside is slimmed after the tool runs — JSON re-encoded losslessly, tables windowed with line numbers, logs folded keeping diagnostics — originals readable byte-for-byte via ctk_retrieve.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-context-toolkit

> [简体中文](./README.zh.md) | **English** | [Changelog](./CHANGELOG.md)

A DeepSeek Harness bundle whose single job is **keeping bulk output out of the conversation**.

It separates *raw bytes* from *conclusions*: commands run in a child process, files are analysed in a sandbox, and long material is filed into a local knowledge base — while the conversation receives only conclusions, excerpts and counts. A routing gate refuses, before execution, the calls that would inevitably flood the transcript.

**No third-party runtime dependencies.** The knowledge base rides on Node's own `node:sqlite` (FTS5 included) and code execution uses interpreters already on the machine, so installing it pulls nothing else.

## What it is for

| Problem | What this does |
|---|---|
| A command prints thousands of lines; you only need a count | `ctk_execute` runs it in a child process and returns the answer |
| A large file needs statistics, not a full read | `ctk_execute_file` keeps its bytes in the sandbox |
| Many commands, one question | `ctk_batch_execute` answers in one call with per-command status |
| A page or spec is read once and never reused | `ctk_index` files it; `ctk_search` pulls excerpts on demand |
| `curl` / `wget` paste whole responses into the conversation | The routing gate refuses them and names the alternative |
| You cannot tell how much was saved | `ctk_stats` reports the ledger; the settings page shows a live occupancy panel |

## Tools

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `ctk_execute` | Run code in a sandboxed child process (javascript / esm / typescript / shell), return only the answer |
| `ctk_execute_file` | Run code over a file for statistics or extraction; the file text stays in the sandbox |
| `ctk_batch_execute` | Several commands in one call, per-command status, conclusions only |
| `ctk_index` | File text or a file into the local FTS5 knowledge base |
| `ctk_search` | Multi-query retrieval; excerpts are centred on the match |
| `ctk_retrieve` | Read back a slimmed output's stored original, byte-for-byte, from its `[ctk_retrieve id=…]` marker |
| `ctk_fetch_and_index` | Fetch pages → strip markup → file them |
| `ctk_purge` | Delete filed material (requires `confirm: true`) |
| `ctk_stats` | Savings ledger: refusals, sandbox bytes, filed bytes, call counts |
| `ctk_doctor` | Self-check: interpreters really start, scratch dir writable, knowledge round-trip |
| `ctk_context_report` | This conversation's context occupancy and composition |

## Install

From npm (recommended):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-context-toolkit
```

From GitHub:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:chimneyQ/dsh-context-toolkit
```

From a local checkout:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add D:\path\to\dsh-context-toolkit
```

Confirm `dsh-context-toolkit` appears in `dsh.profile.bundles` inside `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/desktop/package.json`.

Remove:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-context-toolkit
```

## Use it well

**Reach for `ctk_*` first** whenever the work is analysis, counting, filtering or summarising — reading that output into the conversation is the exact problem this bundle exists to solve.

```js
// How many .log files, and how big in total?
await ctk_execute({
  language: 'javascript',
  code: `
    const fs = require('fs');
    const dir = process.argv[2];
    let n = 0, bytes = 0;
    for (const f of fs.readdirSync(dir)) {
      if (!f.endsWith('.log')) continue;
      n++; bytes += fs.statSync(dir + '/' + f).size;
    }
    console.log(n + ' files, ' + bytes + ' bytes');
  `
});
```

File long material once, then pull sections:

```js
await ctk_index({ path: 'D:/specs/api.md' });          // the full text stays in the store
await ctk_search({ queries: ['rate limit', 'auth'] });  // only the relevant excerpts come back
```

## TLS on a proxy-intercepted network

If every `ctk_fetch_and_index` fails with `UNABLE_TO_VERIFY_LEAF_SIGNATURE`, the machine sits behind a
TLS-inspecting proxy and Node's built-in roots cannot verify what the proxy presents. `caPemPath`
names a PEM to trust instead.

`auto` (the default) points at `<DSH_HOME>/context-mode/ca/windows-roots.pem`. **This package does not
ship that file** — it is a snapshot of the *host's own* root store, so on a fresh machine it simply is
not there and fetching falls back to Node's default roots.

Settings → Context Toolkit shows a row under `caPemPath`:

- a badge saying whether the file exists (and its size), checked with a stat on page load — the bundle
  itself is never read just to render the page;
- a button that writes it from the system root store (`tls.getCACertificates('system')`, ~500
  certificates, ~820 KB) when pressed.

A bundle that already exists is never replaced on a single click: the first press asks, and only the
explicit confirmation overwrites it.

**What this does not do:** it exports the *system* store. If the proxy's root certificate was never
installed into that store — IT pushes it via group policy, for instance — the exported bundle still
will not verify the proxy. Install the root first, then export.

## Configuration

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `routing` | `true` | Master switch for the routing gate |
| `denyCurlWget` | `true` | Block curl / wget outright |
| `bashNudgeMinCommandBytes` | `4096` | Nudge threshold for long commands (0 disables) |
| `maxReadBytesBeforeAsk` | `51200` | Nudge threshold for whole-file reads (0 disables) |
| `nudgeFetchTools` | `true` | Nudge the host fetchers (`web_fetch` / `read_page`) too |
| `trustedReadBasenames` | `package.json` etc. | Filenames exempt from the read nudge |
| `compressNudgeTokens` | `120000` | Occupancy warning threshold (tokens) |
| `searchLimit` | `5` | Excerpts per query in `ctk_search` |
| `snippetChars` | `900` | Character ceiling per excerpt |
| `fetchMaxBytes` | `2000000` | Per-page fetch ceiling |
| `caPemPath` | `auto` | TLS trust store for `ctk_fetch_and_index`: `auto` = `<DSH_HOME>/context-mode/ca/windows-roots.pem`, an absolute PEM path, or empty for Node's default roots. Set it when a TLS-inspecting proxy makes every https fetch fail on the certificate. |
| `storageDir` | empty | Knowledge-base root; empty = `<DSH_HOME>/context-toolkit` |
| `tools.*` | see below | Per-tool switches |

Tool switches: `tools.execute`, `tools.executeFile`, `tools.batchExecute`, `tools.index`, `tools.search`, `tools.fetchAndIndex`, `tools.purge`, `tools.stats`, `tools.contextReport`, `tools.doctor` — all on by default.

## Verify

The offline suites need no DSH runtime:

```bash
node smoke.mjs        # 104 checks: contract, runtime discovery, tools, gate (segment matching, host-aligned path base, script_path and host-fetcher coverage), output slimming with reversible retrieval and retention, CA bundle presence/export, resource disposal, knowledge base, observability, version reporting
node test-client.mjs  # 27 checks: browser-half contract and bilingual dictionary parity
node test-package.mjs # 20 checks: publish manifest and the zero-dependency constraint
node release-check.mjs # 34 checks: release readiness (manifest, deps, tool count, gate matching, version, SHA coverage, no hardcoded paths)
```

## Output slimming (after a tool runs)

The gate works at the *door*; slimming handles what is **already inside**. They catch different traffic: the gate can only read a call's *arguments*, while slimming sees the *bytes that actually came back* — from a tool the gate does not know, an entry point it does not cover, or output that was never predictable from the call.

At `tools/post-execute`, the strategy follows the shape:

| Shape | Treatment |
|---|---|
| Uniform JSON array | **Lossless** tabular re-encoding: keys written once, no information dropped |
| Table | Header plus both ends kept; the middle stride-sampled **with original line numbers** (the model gets a map with coordinates) |
| grep / search | Folded by file, first hits per file kept |
| Log | Ordinary lines folded away, **diagnostics kept verbatim** |
| Long prose | Head/tail window with an explicit elision marker |
| Code / key-value | **Not compressed** (the model may b

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-effort-slider

[English](#english) · [中文](#中文)

A **Codex-style reasoning-effort slider** for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**: it replaces the composer's discrete effort picker with one continuous, **colour-shifting** track — blue at the cool end, violet in the middle, bright lavender at the top.

![preview](preview.png)

---

## English

### The colours

Dragging does not merely lengthen a bar; the fill **heats up** as the effort rises:

| Position | Fill's right end | Feel |
|---|---|---|
| low (≤ 1/3) | `#4D93F8` blue | cool |
| middle (1/3 – 2/3) | blue → `#9333EA` violet | warming |
| high (≥ 2/3) | violet → `#C084FC` lavender | hot |

- The fill always starts blue on the left and blends toward the current accent, producing one continuous gradient.
- A glossy **sheen** layer rides on top of the gradient.
- The track is a **10 px pill**; the knob is a **white circle** with a same-colour ring.
- Tick marks and the current-level label **tint with the same ramp** (blue → indigo → lavender).
- The top stop is deliberately a *bright* lavender rather than a deep purple: deep purple is nearly invisible against the dark composer panel.

The palette follows the colour scheme of OpenAI Codex's reasoning-effort slider (`#4d93f8` / `#9333ea` / `#c084fc`, mixing across thirds of the track). Colour values only — no Codex code is included.

### Interaction

- 1:1 pointer dragging; on release the knob snaps to the nearest level and saves.
- Keyboard: ← / → step one level, Home / End jump to the ends.
- The menu stays open so you can fine-tune; a failed save springs the knob back.
- Registered as a `priority: -1` shadow of `conversation.input.model`, so the stock model seat stays as a fallback.

### Install

```sh
# web surface
dsh plugin --profile web add github:SailingBoat-ovo/dsh-effort-slider

# desktop app
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:SailingBoat-ovo/dsh-effort-slider
```

Or clone and install by path:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/SailingBoat-ovo/dsh-effort-slider
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-effort-slider
```

**Restart DSH afterwards** (restart the app on desktop).

### Compatibility

Works on DSH `0.1.x` (web) and `0.2.1+` (desktop).

On 0.2.x, a traced service method rebinds `this.ctx` to the **caller**, and the `modelDirectories` resolver resolves `remote.session` through that context. Without declaring `remote` / `remote.session` in `inject`, the composer seat crashes with:

```
cannot get property "remote.session" without inject
slot entry crashed in 'conversation.input.model'
```

Both are declared here, and the registration uses the 0.2.x form (`ctx.slots.inject(...)` directly).

### Tests

```sh
npm install
npm test
```

Asserts the registration surface, the `remote.session` declaration, that the inject face resolves, that the component renders, and that **the three fill colours really progress with position** (`#4D93F8` → `#7063F1` → `#BF82FB`).

### License

GPL-3.0-or-later — see [LICENSE](LICENSE) for the full text. Third-party notes in [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md).

---

## 中文

### 配色

拖动时颜色会随档位**"升温"**，不是单纯的进度条变长：

| 位置 | 填充右端颜色 | 观感 |
|---|---|---|
| 低段（≤ 1/3） | `#4D93F8` 蓝 | 冷 |
| 中段（1/3 ~ 2/3） | 蓝 → `#9333EA` 紫罗兰 | 过渡 |
| 高段（≥ 2/3） | 紫罗兰 → `#C084FC` 亮紫 | 热 |

- 填充始终以蓝为左端、向当前档位颜色过渡，形成一条连续渐变；
- 渐变之上叠一层**高光 sheen**；
- 轨道是 **10px 药丸形**，滑块是**白色圆钮**并带同色描边；
- 刻度点与当前档位文字**同样跟色**（蓝 → 靛紫 → 亮紫）；
- 最高档刻意用**亮紫而非深紫**：深紫在深色面板上几乎看不见。

配色参考了 OpenAI Codex 推理强度滑条（`#4d93f8` / `#9333ea` / `#c084fc`，按轨道前中后三段混合），仅取色值，不含 Codex 代码。

### 交互

- 指针 1:1 跟手拖动；松手吸附到最近档位并保存；
- 键盘 ← / → 逐档，Home / End 跳到两端；
- 菜单保持打开便于连续微调；保存失败会回弹；
- 以 `priority: -1` 影子注册 `conversation.input.model`，原模型座位作为兜底。

### 安装

```sh
# Web 版
dsh plugin --profile web add github:SailingBoat-ovo/dsh-effort-slider

# 桌面应用版
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:SailingBoat-ovo/dsh-effort-slider
```

或克隆后按路径安装：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/SailingBoat-ovo/dsh-effort-slider
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-effort-slider
```

**装完重启 DSH**（桌面版重启应用）。

### 兼容性

同时适配 DSH `0.1.x`（Web）与 `0.2.1+`（桌面版）。

在 0.2.x 上，traced 服务方法会把 `this.ctx` 重绑到**调用方**，而 `modelDirectories` 会经由该上下文解析 `remote.session`。若 `inject` 未声明 `remote` / `remote.session`，模型座位会直接崩溃：

```
cannot get property "remote.session" without inject
slot entry crashed in 'conversation.input.model'
```

本插件已声明这两项，并使用 0.2.x 写法（`ctx.slots.inject(...)` 直接注册）。

### 测试

```sh
npm install
npm test
```

覆盖注册面、`remote.session` 声明、注入面可解析、组件渲染，以及**三档填充颜色确实随位置递进**（`#4D93F8` → `#7063F1` → `#BF82FB`）。

### 许可

GPL-3.0-or-later，完整文本见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)；第三方说明见 [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md)。

plugins.description: Split reading from deciding: the root agent plans and owns every file mutation; subagents are structurally read-only and report findings as summaries.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-root-planner-preset

An agent preset for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) that **separates deciding from doing**.

The root agent's context holds the plan and the decisions; reading, editing and running commands go to subagents that report back summaries. Subagents are full workers — they have `write`, `edit` and a shell — and the one thing none of them may leave behind is **a process still running**.

> The root decides, the workers do the work, and nothing outlives the task.

**Requires DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` or newer.** The package declares it as `engines.dsh`, so the plugin manager refuses to install on an older runtime. The floor is not cosmetic: 0.2.1 introduced `agentPreset` on the delegation tool and removed `toolFilter`. On 0.2.0 this preset still composes, and then quietly runs every child on the platform's default preset — wrong persona, twice the tools — which is worse than not installing it at all.

[中文说明](README.zh.md) | [Install](INSTALL.md) | [Maintainer notes](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)

## The problem it solves

On a long task a coding agent's context fills up with raw file contents and command output, and it forgets the goal, loses the plan, and starts repeating work. The usual answer — "delegate more to subagents" — fails in two opposite directions: a delegate with no hands cannot do anything, so every step bounces back; and a fleet of delegates with no bounds will edit whatever they like and leave servers running.

This preset takes the middle line: **workers with tools, bounded by their task.**

| Requirement | Mechanism | Strength |
|---|---|---|
| A subagent can read, **edit files and run commands** | The `root-planner-worker` preset mounts `tool-fs`, `tool-pwsh`, `tool-web` and the delegation rows; every delegation spawns into that preset by name | Grant by construction — a worker without tools is not a worker |
| A subagent cannot leave a process running | `enableRunInBackground: false` on the preset's `pwsh` row: the call is refused **and** `run_in_background` is removed from the tool schema | **Structural** — no model at any depth can reach for a detached process |
| Nobody runs an unbounded service | Persona rules for the root and for subagents | Prompt-level, covering what a schema cannot (`ops_bash` has no job registry) |
| A subagent stays inside its own workspace | Persona rules: write only under `_agents/<label>/`, the parent's files read-only to it, outside changes sent as a request | Prompt-level, **verified** by the parent (see below) |
| Delegation depth is the user's setting | The runtime depth cap (`subagent.maxDepth`) | **Structural**: past the cap it throws `SubagentDepthError` |
| Live children are capped as well | `subagent.maxActiveSubagents` | **Structural**: past the cap a delegation fails with `subagent limit reached`, and it does not queue |
| The root decides; workers execute | Persona rules | Prompt-level |

The worker's toolset is an **allow list by construction**: a tool exists for a worker only if the worker preset mounts the plugin that provides it. A tool added by a future plugin — or by the app — is invisible to workers until a row is added here.

One caveat, measured rather than assumed: a small number of tools are registered **globally** by the Host and cannot be removed by any preset. On 0.2.1-rc.2 those were `ops_glob`, `ops_grep`, `ops_inspect_local_file`, `ops_replace` (from the `dsh-ops` plugin) and `working_directory`. A worker sees them whatever this package does; the curated set below is what the rows add on top.

### One workspace per worker

Concurrency is handled by separation rather than by coordination. Before delegating,
the root creates `_agents/<label>/` and puts that absolute path in the task; the child
writes **only** there, reads the parent's files freely, and sends a change request
instead of editing anything outside. On completion the child reports its artifacts and
the root decides which to copy in — merging into an existing file where that is what the
change means, keeping them separate where it is not. `_agents/` stays (and belongs in
`.gitignore`) so the same agent can be continued later.

**The boundary is enforced, not just agreed.** This preset's package also ships the fence
as a profile-level entry (`dsh-root-planner-preset/guard`), so one install carries the
protocol and its enforcement together. It refuses a `write`, `edit` or `ops_replace` whose
target resolves outside `<workspace>/_agents/`, and refuses a shell call whose `workdir` is
outside it or whose command names an absolute path into your files:

```
write: outside your workspace. You may write only inside "...\_agents"; everything else
in the parent's directory is read-only to you. Send your parent a change request instead
of writing "...\report.md" directly.
```

The root session is never fenced: it owns the workspace and has to be able to write
anywhere in it to integrate a child's artifacts.

**Being profile-level, it fences every delegated agent in this profile** — including
subagents under a different preset, which were never told about `_agents/`. If that matters
on your machine, turn the entry off in your profile patch:

```yaml
- id: root-planner-guard
  disabled: true
```

Declaring the guard as a row *inside* the preset would scope it to this preset only, and
that was tried first: measured against a live session it registered nothing — six probe
steps all came back allowed while the composed config looked correct. `verify-patch.mjs`
now fails if anyone declares it as a preset row again.

One limitation survives, and it is worth knowing before you rely on this: a shell command
can build a path at runtime (`$env:X` + `'..'`, a script that writes, a Here-String), and
no argument scan can see it. The command scan matches **drive-letter** paths, so on POSIX
it detects nothing at all — the two CI cases for it are skipped there rather than pretending
otherwise. Confining a child's shell properly would need a narrower
sandbox write root, which DSH cannot give a child — `sandboxPolicy.resolve()` accepts only
`{ session, mode }` and derives `workspaceRoot` from the immutable, inherited
`session.header.cwd`. So keep the parent's check as the backstop:

```sh
# before delegating
touch _agents/.mark-<label>
# after the child reports
find . -path ./_agents -prune -o -type f -newer _agents/.mark-<label> -print
```

No output means the child touched nothing outside its own directory; any output is a
file to inspect. The command needs no git repository — which matters, because the
workspace this was developed against is not one.

### Two limits you will meet on a broad task

Both are Host settings, both are structural, and both are documented because they read
like defects the first time:

- **`subagent limit reached (active child limit: N)`** — a delegated child is
  *resident*, not merely running: a slot returns only after its turn ends, its inbox
  is empty, and its own children are disposed. A wide fan-out therefore holds every
  slot until that work actually finishes, and the batch does not queue behind the
  cap. Raise `maxActiveSubagents` (**Settings → Subagents**) if the machine can
  carry more live agents, or dispatch a batch you can finish and collect it before
  opening the next. The author's own profile carries 16 for this reason.
- **`subagent depth N exceeds maxDepth M`** — a delegation from a leaf. That is the
  cap working, not a failure; the child reads the material itself.

## How it works

```
root agent  ──delegates──▶  subagent  ──delegates──▶  … until maxDepth
   │                            │
   └── decides, integrates, and states what each worker may touch
```

Two mechanisms decide what a worker gets and how far the tree goes, and they pull in the
same direction:

- **The worker preset** gives *every* subagent, at *every* level, the same working set —
  read, write, shell — and withholds the same things, because each level spawns into the
  same preset. The grant does not weaken with depth, and neither does the bound.
- **The depth cap** (`subagent.maxDepth`, a Host setting you control) decides how
  many levels exist. `2` means root →

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ios-simulator-helper

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)
![platform: macOS](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-macOS-lightgrey.svg)
[![target: DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%3E%3D0.2.1--rc.2-blue.svg)](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) native port of the official ZCode `ios-simulator@0.1.0` plugin: all 20 original MCP tools preserved as native DSH tools, plus a **parameter page on the plugin's own detail page** in the Plugins panel (Plugins → Installed plugins → iOS Simulator Helper) that edits the simulator parameters in-app instead of through environment variables.

- Tool and argument names are identical to the original, so workflows written for the `ios_simulator` MCP server keep working; one tool is added — `ios_shutdown_simulator`, because the original could boot a simulator but never stop one.
- 17 settings fields in 5 groups, all live-editable; an empty field falls back to the original plugin's `IOS_SIM_*` variable, then to the built-in default.
- The parameter page detects the host system and, **on a non-macOS host, states that this plugin only supports macOS**; every tool that drives Apple tooling then refuses with a clear message instead of failing with `spawn xcrun ENOENT`, while `ios_preflight` reports the failing host check and `ios_discover_project`, `ios_create_app` and `ios_ui_status` still answer.
- Published as `@zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper`; the plugin page shows **iOS Simulator Helper** / **iOS 模拟器助手** from `locale/` rather than the raw package name, and both descriptions say the plugin is unofficial and not affiliated with Apple.

## Quick start

On a Mac with full Xcode, at least one iOS runtime and DSH installed:

1. **Install the plugin**

   ```bash
   dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper
   ```

   In DSH Desktop, open **Plugins** and add the same package name there. Reload or restart DSH afterwards.

2. **Check the machine** — open **Plugins → Installed plugins → iOS Simulator Helper** and press **Run diagnostic**. It runs exactly the checks `ios_preflight` runs (full Xcode, a simulator runtime, `idb`), and prints a fix for anything missing.

3. **Use it** — ask for what you want ("build and run this project on the iPhone 16 simulator", "screenshot the running app"), or call the 21 `ios_*` tools directly. Everything the tools need is editable on that page.

## Contents

- [Quick start](#quick-start)
- [Requirements](#requirements)
- [Install](#install)
- [Configuration page](#configuration-page)
- [Screenshots](#screenshots)
- [Tools](#tools)
- [Skill and slash command](#skill-and-slash-command)
- [Differences from the original](#differences-from-the-original)
- [Known limitations](#known-limitations)
- [Releases](#releases)
- [Contributing](#contributing)
- [License](#license)

## Requirements

| Dependency | Notes |
|---|---|
| macOS | The only supported host. `xcrun simctl`, `xcodebuild` and the simulator window app exist nowhere else. |
| Full Xcode | `xcode-select -p` must point at `Xcode.app/Contents/Developer`; Command Line Tools alone are not enough. |
| An iOS Simulator runtime | At least one iOS/iPadOS runtime installed from Xcode → Settings → Platforms. |
| Node.js ≥ 22 | The DSH host runtime. |
| `idb` (optional) | Needed only by the `ios_ui_*` tools. Without it, build/run/screenshot/logs are unaffected. |

`ios_preflight` checks every item above and prints a fix for each failure; the parameter page's "Run diagnostic" button runs the same checks.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper
```

**DSH Desktop**: the `desktop` profile belongs to the Electron app — open **Plugins**, add `@zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper` there, and enable the row it creates. After a reload or restart the form is at **Plugins → Installed plugins → iOS Simulator Helper**; it only appears while the host half actually serves this plugin's settings namespace.

The published tarball contains everything the plugin needs — the host half, the browser bundle, the bundled skill and the `locale/` entries — and nothing is compiled at install time, so no build approval step is involved. `@deepseek-ai/cordis`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` are **peer dependencies** provided by the harness, so the plugin pulls in no second copy and has **no runtime dependencies** of its own; DSH's compatibility gate compares the `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer ranges against the running version and refuses to install on a mismatch.

> Mount the package exactly once. `dsh plugin add` records the row in `dsh.profile.bundles`; adding a second row for the same package in the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` registers every tool name twice and fails at the loader.

### Upgrade and uninstall

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper@latest   # upgrade
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove @zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper      # uninstall
```

Settings live in the profile, not in the package, so both commands leave them in place. The data directory (by default `$DSH_HOME/ios-simulator-helper`) holds screenshots, build logs and DerivedData; it is yours to delete, and uninstalling does not touch it.

### Version gate

The DSH compatibility range is **`>=0.2.1-rc.2`, a lower bound only**, declared identically in `peerDependencies`, `engines.dsh` and `dsh.compatibility.dsh`: a runtime below it is refused at install time, and no future harness release is excluded.

One node-semver detail survives — a **new tuple's** prerelease such as `0.2.2-alpha.1` is not admitted by npm's and pnpm's default rules, so that install fails until either the range gains a branch for the tuple (`">=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.2.2-0 || >=0.2.2-0"`) or the peer check is skipped:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper \
  --config.strict-peer-dependencies=false
```

Stable releases (`0.2.1`, `0.2.2`, `0.3.0`, `1.0.0`, …) are unaffected and always admitted.

## Configuration page

The settings namespace equals the profile patch row id equals `ios-simulator-helper` (also `dsh.name`). The form registers with the Plugins page's `plugins.bundle.config` slot, keyed by the package name, so it renders inside the plugin's detail page in the Plugins panel instead of in the Settings dialog; it exists only while the host half serves that namespace. It reads and writes through `ctx.configForms`, so staged edits, dirty detection, inline validation, optimistic concurrency (revisions) and "overridden / reset to default" all come from the harness. The detail page draws the plugin's title, icon and description; the form contributes one line saying when an edit takes effect, one card per category — built from the same field kit as the built-in settings pages (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`) — and the save bar. The three timeouts are entered in whole seconds, while the legacy `IOS_SIM_*_MS` variables are still read in milliseconds and converted.

Saving happens in a pill that sticks to the bottom of the form: it appears while edits are staged (or a write is in flight, or one failed), names that state next to a status dot, and carries **Discard changes** and **Save** (disabled while a draft is invalid). A draft that merely puts a control back to the value already in effect counts as no edit at all, a confirmation toast reports a write that landed, and leaving the page discards staged edits.

| Group | Field | Type | Default | Legacy env fallback | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Simulator and device | `defaultDevice` | text (suggestions from this machine) | `iPhone 16` | `IOS_SIM_DEFAULT_DEVICE` | Device-name fragment used when a tool names no `udid`/`device`; falls back to the first available iPhone on a miss. |
| | `defaultRuntime` | text (suggestions from installed runtimes) | empty | `IOS_SIM_DEFAULT_RUNTIME` | Runtime fragment suc

# dsh-dschat

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-dschat.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-dschat)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-dschat.svg)](https://github.com/Jakcet/dsh-dschat/blob/main/LICENSE)

把 DeepSeek 网页版聊天（[chat.deepseek.com](https://chat.deepseek.com/)）装进 **DSH 桌面版**的面板里。

侧栏会多一个「DeepSeek 网页版」图标，点开就是一个主面板，里面用 Electron `<webview>` 原样载入网页版，工具栏可以后退、前进、刷新、回首页、在系统浏览器打开。登录在 DeepSeek 自己的页面上完成，插件不接触你的密码。

> 这个面板需要 `globalThis.dshDesktop.browser`，它只由 DSH 桌面版的 preload 暴露；Web 版只会显示一行提示。

## 功能

- **侧栏入口 + 主面板**：keyed panel，图标是蓝色鲸鱼气泡。
- **工具栏**：后退、前进、刷新、回 DeepSeek 首页、当前地址、在系统浏览器中打开。
- **原样加载** `https://chat.deepseek.com/`，不改页面、不注入脚本（只在你登录后读一次 `localStorage` 做快照）。
- **登录快照**：DSH 侧栏浏览器的 partition 是进程内内存分区，应用重启就丢 cookie。登录后插件把页面 `localStorage` 里登录相关的键备份到 `~/.dsh/dsh-dschat/storage.json`（权限 `0600`），下次载入时先回填、再刷新页面。
  能不能因此完全跳过登录页，取决于网页版把会话放在哪里：`httpOnly` cookie 不在快照范围内。

## 安装

在 DSH 插件市场里搜索 `dsh-dschat` 安装，或手动作为 bundle 装进你的 DSH profile：

```sh
npm install dsh-dschat
```

## 要求

- **DSH 桌面版**（依赖 preload 暴露的 `globalThis.dshDesktop.browser`）。
- DSH `>= 0.2.1-rc.2`。

## 它是怎么工作的

1. 主面板挂载时，client 半部向 DSH 桌面版的 preload 桥申请一个 guest：`globalThis.dshDesktop.browser.acquire(workspace)`。
2. 拿到 `{ lease, partition }` 后创建 `<webview>`，`name` 填 lease、`partition` 填 partition、`src` 填 `about:blank#<lease>`；DSH 主进程会在 `will-attach-webview` 里校验 lease 和 partition，通过后才真正挂载。
3. pages 加载完成（`dom-ready`）后 `loadURL('https://chat.deepseek.com/')`。
4. 登录态变化后，把 `localStorage` 里键名匹配 `token/user/auth/session/login` 的字符串值 POST 给插件的 host 路由，写到本地快照文件；下次打开时先回填再刷新。
5. 面板卸载时 `bridge.release(lease)` 释放 guest。

因为走的是和内置侧栏浏览器同一套 lease 校验、sandbox 与导航策略，插件本身拿不到 Electron/Node 权限。

## 已知限制（来自 DSH 宿主策略，插件绕不过去）

- guest 内发起的**下载会被取消**。
- 通知、麦克风、剪贴板等**权限请求一律拒绝**。
- 窗口打开请求会转成同面板内导航。
- 浏览器 partition 每次启动重建，用公开 API 做不到「完全零登录」重启。
- 只有桌面版可用，Web 版不工作。

## 隐私

插件不代理、不抓取、不转发任何内容，只渲染官方页面并保留一份本地快照。快照里可能有登录相关数据的明文，请当作 cookie 文件对待，不要分享；删掉 `~/.dsh/dsh-dschat/storage.json` 即可清除快照。

## 文件

- `index.js` — host 半部：快照与日志的 HTTP 路由，以及一次性的客户端模块清单缓存刷新。
- `client.js` — client 半部：侧栏图标、主面板、webview 生命周期、工具栏。
- `cordis.patch.yml` — bundle patch。
- `icon.svg` — 插件图标。

## License

MIT

---

# English

Embed the DeepSeek web chat (`chat.deepseek.com`) in a **DSH Desktop** main panel.

A sidebar entry opens a keyed main panel that hosts the real DeepSeek web app inside an
Electron `<webview>` guest, requested from the DSH desktop preload bridge
(`globalThis.dshDesktop.browser.acquire`) so it goes through the same main-process lease
check, sandbox flags and navigation policy as the built-in sidebar browser.

## What it does

- Adds a **DeepSeek Web** entry to the sidebar icon list and a main panel.
- Toolbar: back, forward, reload, home, current URL, open in system browser.
- Loads `https://chat.deepseek.com/` unmodified. Sign-in happens on DeepSeek's own page;
  the plugin never sees or stores your password.
- **Login snapshot.** DSH's sidebar-browser partition is a process-local in-memory
  partition, so cookies are gone after an app restart. After you sign in, the plugin copies
  login-related `localStorage` keys to `~/.dsh/dsh-dschat/storage.json` (mode `0600`) and
  restores them on the next load before reloading the page. Whether that is enough to skip
  the sign-in screen depends on where DeepSeek keeps the session: `httpOnly` cookies are
  not part of the snapshot.

## Install

Install it from the DSH plugin market (search for `dsh-dschat`), or add this package as a
bundle to your DSH profile:

```sh
npm install dsh-dschat
```

## Requirements

- **DSH Desktop.** The panel needs `globalThis.dshDesktop.browser`, which only the desktop
  preload exposes. In the web build the panel shows a notice and does nothing.
- DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.2`.

## Known limits (enforced by the DSH host, not by this plugin)

- Downloads started inside the guest are cancelled.
- Permission requests (notifications, microphone, clipboard) are denied.
- Window-open requests are turned into navigation in the same panel.
- The browser partition is recreated on every app start, so a fully zero-login restart is
  not possible with the public host API.

## Privacy

The plugin does not proxy, scrape or forward anything. It renders the official page and
keeps one local snapshot file. That file can contain login-related values in plain text;
treat it like a cookie jar and do not share it. Delete it to forget the snapshot.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Portable project memory for coding agents. Standalone runtime, observable records, code fingerprints, and Claude Code/Codex/DeepSeek Harness adapters.
plugins.readme_text:
# Remvu

[![Tests](https://github.com/caotaiyi/remvu/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/caotaiyi/remvu/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Standalone and DSH](https://github.com/caotaiyi/remvu/actions/workflows/standalone.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/caotaiyi/remvu/actions/workflows/standalone.yml)

Save before Claude Code hits its limit. Continue in Codex with the project background intact.

Remvu keeps goals, constraints, rejected approaches, unfinished work and check evidence alongside your project. The complete standalone engine bundles its runtime: **users do not install Python**. Opt-in observable recording, code fingerprints, concurrent updates, recovery and private sharing boundaries remain part of the engine.

[中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Install](docs/quickstart.md) · [DeepSeek Harness plugin](adapters/dsh/README.md) · [Evidence and limits](docs/standalone.md)

Fresh installations create no hooks. Recording is a separate choice; fingerprints, CAS protection and recovery stay available in manual mode. Resume reads a short preview; details are fetched only when needed.

## Try the complete app

> Install the complete Remvu standalone candidate from https://github.com/caotaiyi/remvu for my OS and architecture. Verify its checksum, extract the entire application folder, then run its install command for this project. Preserve existing settings and memory. Install save/resume without hooks. Enable recording only if I ask; explain any required client trust once. Do not install a system Python or substitute the notes-only fallback.

The v0.3.0-beta.3 application is a test candidate. CI produces platform archives; a production release and the full native-client support matrix remain gated on actual acceptance. See [the build and installation guide](docs/standalone.md) for available artifacts, verification and exact steps. Git is still required. macOS distribution signing/notarization is not configured.

| Everyday action | Claude Code | Codex |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Save a private handoff | `/remvu save` | `$remvu save` |
| Continue in a new session | `/remvu resume` | `$remvu resume` |

`save` asks the current agent to consolidate reviewed evidence and exports `.remvu/handoff/REMVU.md`. A direct program invocation without a proposal exports existing state and leaves pending evidence pending. It never uploads or commits. `resume` checks the saved code state before continuing. The receiver can also read the handoff alongside the code without installing Remvu.

Save while the original agent can still respond. Automatic logs retain observations; they cannot recover an exhausted agent's unwritten understanding. Stop hooks do not block completion or force another model turn.

## A handoff in 30 seconds

1. In Claude Code, ask `/remvu save`.
2. Open the project in Codex and ask `$remvu resume`.
3. Review the next step and any stale checks, pending evidence or conflicts, then continue.

This describes the workflow, not a measured completion-time guarantee. [Earlier real handoff trials](docs/validation-report.md) and the [10-task notes-only comparison](docs/product-validation.md) are published with their limits. The latter found no first-pass accuracy advantage over ordinary HANDOFF notes; it does not measure the new standalone app or prove token savings.

## DeepSeek Harness

The `dsh-remvu` bundle adds five native tools and observable event recording to DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2**. It uses the same standalone engine and `.remvu/` state. The JavaScript package needs no compilation or install-time build script. [Install the plugin](adapters/dsh/README.md).

The plugin was installed through the official `dsh plugin add` flow and loaded in a real isolated SDK profile without a model request. Model-driven handoff and GUI acceptance are separate pending checks. Local projects only; it does not claim cloud or remote-filesystem support.

## What stays in memory

Claims distinguish `user_confirmed`, `observed`, `inferred` and `unverified`. Rejected decisions and superseded history survive. Check results retain the code fingerprint they actually tested; later edits make those checks historical. Concurrent proposals cannot silently overwrite newer memory.

Private memory and detailed evidence stay in ignored `.remvu/`. Public `REMVU.md` is generated only on an explicit share request, with public inline evidence and patch review. Hidden reasoning, credentials and unrelated conversations are excluded. `doctor`, `repair`, upgrades, rollback and uninstall remain available when needed; uninstall retains private memory.

## For multi-model platforms and API relay services

“换模型、换客户端，把项目背景一起带走。” A platform that can observe local project changes and tool outcomes can embed the memory engine or build an adapter. Pure API forwarding has no complete view of the project and cannot promise full operation records. The DSH adapter is a concrete local-host integration; no generic relay integration or measured savings percentage is claimed.

## Other paths and contributors

A [notes-only fallback](skills/remvu/assets/markdown-skill.md) remains available for users who deliberately want file-tool save/resume without recording or structured validation. Source developers can still run the standard-library Python engine. Neither path replaces the complete standalone app.

[Open format](spec/README.md) · [Compatibility](docs/compatibility.md) · [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [License](LICENSE). Existing `remvu/1` documents and legacy evidence import remain supported.

plugins.description: DSH 会话管理插件：删除（回收站恢复/彻底清除/一键清空）、强制删除异常会话、恢复归档会话、统计、继续/暂停、打开日志目录、未读标记、工作区分组与排序、上下文压缩阈值。DSH session manager: recoverable trash, empty trash, force delete, stats, continue/pause, log folder, workspace grouping, compaction threshold.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-session-manager [中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md) 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面中全面**管理会话**：设置页与对话顶部均提供入口——删除（回收站可恢复、可彻底清除、可一键清空）、恢复已归档会话、近期活动统计、继续/暂停会话、打开日志目录、未读/已读标记、新聊天中继续（fork）、工作区分组与排序管理、上下文压缩阈值设置，不修改 DSH 核心代码。 本仓库基于 [dream12347/dsh-session-manager](https://github.com/dream12347/dsh-session-manager)（MIT）的 v0.2.3 构建产物， 在其上发布 **v0.4.1**：DSH 原生风格确认弹窗、更宽的会话 ID 兼容、**强制删除**、**一键清空回收站**， 并修复了重挂载时路由重复注册导致宿主启动失败的问题。功能列表与实现说明沿用上游。 上游项目由 dsh + Deepseek-V4-Flash0731 完成；本仓库为其衍生版本，遵循 MIT。 ## v0.4.1 相对上游的改动 | # | 改动 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | 1 | **原生确认弹窗** | 所有 `window.confirm()` / `window.alert()` 换成 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 的官方 `Modal`：遮罩模糊、Esc 关闭、焦点归还、危险动作使用 `--dsw-alias-state-error-primary`，会话 ID 以等宽字体展示。彻底告别桌面端弹出的系统消息框 | | 2 | **更宽的会话 ID 兼容** | 原来只接受 `session-`，遇到 `od-` 一类由其它入口铸造的 ID 会直接返回 `invalid-session-id`，导致「删不掉」。现在接受任意可安全用作单层路径的 ID（`[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,199}`，禁止 `..`） | | 3 | **强制删除** | 常规删除失败时，失败弹窗直接给出「强制删除」：跳过官方归档校验、按磁盘目录兜底定位会话目录，直接移入回收站（仍可恢复）。`POST /dsh-session-manager/delete` 接受 `{ sessionId, force: true }`；运行中的会话依旧拒绝 | | 4 | **一键清空回收站** | 回收站新增「清空回收站」按钮，经 `POST /dsh-session-manager/purge-all` 一次性永久清除全部条目与其磁盘目录；部分条目删除失败时保留其记录以便重试，并回报 `purged` / `failed` / `remaining` | | 5 | **路由注册崩溃修复** | `webServer.register()` 对重复 `(kind, path)` 是硬抛错。插件重挂载（配置重载 / 禁用启用 / 服务替换）会重复注册 9 条路由而旧注册未释放，异常沿 `apply()` 逃逸，**宿主启动直接失败**。现在改用进程级路由表：新挂载先接管（释放旧注册再注册），仍冲突只记日志；`setup()` 失败也被 `apply()` 兜住，插件不激活但宿主继续运行 | | 6 | **删除入口迁移** | 移除了对话顶部的红色「删除本对话」按钮，改到侧边栏会话行「…」菜单（`sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item`，order 500，danger 行），与置顶/重命名/分叉/归档/复制 ID 同处一个菜单，避免占据对话标题栏 | ## 功能 - 设置页新增独立的「会话管理」分栏（与 Notifications 同级的设置分区） - 面板列出全部会话（标题 / 工作目录），底部折叠区单独展示**已归档会话**，支持**一键恢复**回到会话列表 - **回收站**：删除的会话移入回收站（保留最近 10 条，超出自动清除最早一条），可**恢复**或**彻底删除** - **统计**：每个会话可在居中弹窗中查看完整近期活动统计（轮次 / 用户消息 / 助手消息 / 全部工具调用 / 活动窗口） - **继续会话**：一键打开会话并关闭面板；**暂停**：停止正在运行会话的当前回合 - **未读 / 已读**：会话行标题旁显示状态点——手动未读为蓝色、官方等待输入为琥珀、官方完成提醒为绿色、运行中为转圈；点击官方状态点**就地已读**（不跳转），点击蓝色点清除未读，打开会话自动已读；官方侧边栏的对应会话行旁同步显示蓝色未读点 - **新聊天中继续**：每个会话一键 fork 子会话（官方 `sessions.fork`）并打开 - **文件夹**：在系统文件管理器中打开会话日志目录 - **删除会话（菜单入口）**：侧边栏会话行的「…」菜单里新增红色「删除本对话」项，位于「复制 Session ID」之后并单独成组；确认后移入回收站 - **对话管理 / 回收站**：对话顶部入口，打开自绘右侧抽屉（图钉固定常驻、点击外部自动收起），行内「更多」悬浮菜单收纳统计 / 文件夹 / 新聊天中继续 - **工作区管理**：会话按工作区分组展示，组内按最后使用时间排序（可切换最新/最旧）；拖拽工作区标题即可调整顺序（插入 / 交换 / 拖到末尾）；悬停标题出现**置于顶部 / 重命名 / 删除**按钮（删除按官方定义：仅移出列表，文件夹与会话记录保留，会话归入「未分组」） - **上下文压缩阈值**（通用设置）：设置对话上下文用到模型窗口（100 万 token）的多少比例时自动压缩（17%–90%），每次压缩保留最近 16% 原文；**对所有 Agent 预设的会话统一生效**（保存即时 + 持久化 + 重启自动应用） - 删除限制：仅禁止删除「正在思考」的会话；当前打开的会话（空闲）可删除 - 子代理（subagent）会话支持删除（非运行中）：即使主会话已删除、子代理成为「孤儿」，也能在会话管理中直接清理 - 中英文界面自适应（跟随页面语言） ## 安装 ### 从 Release（推荐） ```sh dsh plugin --profile add https://github.com/JeffKeeping/dsh-session-manager/releases/latest/download/dsh-session-manager.tgz ``` 也可以先下载 `dsh-session-manager.tgz` 再本地安装： ```sh dsh plugin --profile add /absolute/path/to/dsh-session-manager.tgz ``` > 本地目录安装是 **link** 方式，安装后不要移动或删除该目录。 ### 从 GitHub ```sh dsh plugin --profile add 'github:JeffKeeping/dsh-session-manager#v0.4.1' ``` ### 从本地目录 ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-session-manager ``` ### 从 tarball ```sh pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-session-manager-0.2.2.tgz ``` 安装完成后**重启** `dsh web`（host 插件与客户端 bundle 需要重启加载）。 ## 截图 ### 1. 设置页 · 会话管理 ![设置页会话管理](assets/session-manager-settings.png) - 左侧导航新增独立「会话管理」分栏（与 账号与余额 / 通用设置 同级） - 会话按**工作区**分组（test1 / test / code），组标题带数量 - 每行左侧是标题与工作目录，右侧依次为 **继续会话 / 新聊天中继续 / 统计 / 文件夹 / 删除**；运行中的会话显示「运行中」并禁用「继续会话」 - 顶部：**全选**、已选计数、**批量删除**；右上角排序切换（最新在前） - 底部折叠区：**已归档会话** 与 **回收站（1/10）**，回收站下方是 **清空回收站** ### 2. 会话行「…」菜单 ![会话行菜单](assets/session-row-menu.png) 侧边栏任意会话行悬停右侧的「…」，菜单自上而下为：**置顶会话 / 重命名（Ctrl+Alt+G）/ 分叉会话（Ctrl+Alt+F）/ 归档会话（Ctrl+Shift+A）/ 复制 Session ID**，最下方一条分隔线之后是本插件新增的红色危险项 **删除本对话**。 ### 3. 会话管理抽屉 ![会话管理抽屉](assets/session-manager-drawer.png) 从对话顶部 **对话管理** 打开的自绘右侧抽屉，数据与设置页同源： - 每行：**继续会话 / 更多 / 删除**，「更多」收纳 统计、文件夹、新聊天中继续 - 运行中的会话标「运行中」，按钮置灰 - 底部：**已归档会话 (10)**、**回收站 (1/10)** 与 **清空回收站** ### 4. 通用设置 · 上下文压缩阈值 ![上下文压缩阈值](assets/general-settings.png) 滑块 + 输入框设置 17%–90%，保存后立即生效，且对所有 Agent 预设的会话统一生效。 ## 使用 ### 设置页会话管理 1. 打开侧边栏底部 **设置**（齿轮图标） 2. 设置页面左侧导航出现独立的 **会话管理** 分栏，点击进入 3. 主列表为未归档会话；底部「已归档会话」折叠区可展开查看、**恢复**或删除归档会话 4. 删除会话 → 进入底部「回收站」折叠区（保留最近 10 条） 5. 回收站内可 **恢复**（回到会话列表）或 **彻底删除**（永久清除，不可恢复） 6. 每行操作：**继续会话**（打开并进入对话）、**暂停**（停止正在运行的回合）、**统计**（展开近期活动）、**文件夹**（打开日志目录）、**删除** 7. 工作区标题右侧（悬停显示）：**置于顶部**（挪到最前）、**重命名**、**删除**（红色，二次确认） 8. 拖拽工作区标题可调整顺序：放到某个工作区上方/下方插入，放到标题上交换位置，拖到最下方即移到末尾 9. 排序按钮（最新在前 / 最旧在前）切换组内会话的排列顺序 ### 通用设置：上下文压缩阈值 1. 打开 **设置** → **通用设置**（General） 2. 找到「上下文压缩阈值」：滑块 / 输入框设置 17%–90% 3. 保存后立即生效（含已打开的会话）；配置对所有 Agent 预设统一生效，重启后依然有效 ### 删除会话（会话行「…」菜单） 侧边栏任意会话行悬停出现「…」，菜单原有 置顶 / 重命名 / 分叉 / 归档 / 复制 Session ID， 最下方新增一组红色 **删除本对话**： 1. 点击后弹出 DSH 原生确认框（显示会话标题与 Session ID） 2. 确认即移入回收站，可在设置页「会话管理 → 回收站」恢复或彻底删除 3. 若宿主返回错误（例如目录无法解析），弹窗直接提供 **强制删除** > 会话标题旁的删除按钮不再出现在对话顶部；顶部仍保留 **对话管理** 与 **回收站** 两个入口。 ### 未读 / 已读状态点 会话行标题旁的圆点表示四种状态：**蓝色**=手动标记未读、**琥珀**=官方等待输入、**绿色**=官方完成提醒、**转圈**=运行中。点击琥珀 / 绿色点**就地标记已读**（不跳转，仅清除官方提醒）；点击蓝色点清除未读；点击空白位置标记未读；打开会话自动已读。官方侧边栏的会话行旁同步显示蓝色未读点（按标题文本匹配，重复标题会话会共享该点）。 ## 强制删除（v0.3.0+） 当某个会话的 ID 不属于官方目录（例如由其它入口铸造的 `od-`），或归档步骤异常时，常规删除会报错。 此时失败弹窗会显示会话 ID 与宿主返回的错误码，并提供 **强制删除**：跳过官方归档校验、按 `~/.dsh/sessions//` 扫描定位会话目录，再移入回收站（**可以恢复**）；正在运行的会话依然拒绝。 ## 清空回收站（v0.4.0+） 回收站展开后底部有 **清空回收站** 按钮：确认后一次性永久删除回收站中的全部会话（含 `~/.dsh/dsh-delete-session-trash/` 下的目录），**不可恢复**。个别条目删除失败时会保留其记录以便重试， 弹窗会报告成功与失败数量。 ## 工作原理 | 层 | 实现 | |---|---| | Host | `src/index.ts` 注册 9 条路由：`POST /delete`（归档 + 非 live 会话文件移入回收站 + 记录条目，支持 `force`）、`POST /restore`（文件移回 + 取消归档 + 删除条目）、`POST /purge`（清除单个回收站条目与文件）、`POST /purge-all`（清空回收站）、`GET /trash`（回收站列表）、`POST /open-folder`（打开日志目录）、`POST /pause`（暂停运行中会话）、`GET\|POST /compaction-threshold`（读写全局压缩阈值）、`GET /stats`（活动统计）。通过 `ctx.sessionPersistence` 定位会话、`ctx.workspaceRegistry` 归档/取消归档、`ctx.storageDomain` 持久化回收站条目、归档集合与阈值；`ctx.agents` 检测运行中的会话并拒绝删除 | | Client | `src/client/index.ts` 通过官方 `settings.section` 插槽注册独立分栏，用 `useSessions` / `useWorkspaces` 标准数据源列出会话（含归档/回收站分组），删除/恢复/彻底删除调用 host 路由；抽屉通过 `sessions.list`（ObservableSnapshot）订阅实时列表；彻底删除的会话 id 记录在浏览器 localStorage，避免 live 会话删除后刷新「复活」 | - **未读机制**：手动未读集保存在浏览器 localStorage 的共享 key `dsh.session-unread.v1`（`{version:1, ids:[]}` 格式，与其他会话管理插件互通）；官方状态点（琥珀/绿色/转圈）由官方 `SessionSummary` 的 `pendingInteraction` / `completed` / `running` 字段驱动，点击就地已读通过清除官方提醒标记实现，无需打开会话；侧边栏的蓝色未读点由 MutationObserver 装饰官方树节点（官方行元素没有会话 id 属性，故按标题文本匹配） - **压缩阈值全局生效**：保存在存储域（`dsh_delete_session` 的 `thresholdRatio`）；如果默认 Agent 预设是用户预设，则同时写入 agent-presets 服务解析出的 `agent.cordis.yml`，系统预设文件保持只读。host 在每个 `agent/pre-step` 钩子里把阈值写入所有预设的压缩引擎配置，因此对所有 Agent 预设的会话统一生效，重启后依然有效 - 删除时先走官方归档通道：侧边栏立即隐藏该会话 - 回收站条目持久化在 DSH 存储域（`~/.dsh/storages/dsh_delete_session.json`），文件在 `~/.dsh/dsh-delete-session-trash/` - 工作区记账（`sessionIds` 槽位）在下次启动时由 registry 重建索引自动对账，无需手动编辑文件 - 无系统提示词改动、无模型工具新增，对 token 与模型行为零影响 ## 限制 - **不能删除正在运行的会话**（按钮禁用并拒绝删除），多标签页场景请先在别处确认该会话已停止 - **子代理会话可删除**（非运行中），包括主会话已删除的「孤儿子代理」——不会再有无法清理的残留会话 - live 会话（当前进程内打开的会话）删除后，其内存状态由 DSH 在重启时彻底清理 - 已彻底删除的会话 id 会保留在浏览器 localStorage（防止刷新后重新出现）与归档集合中（无害残留，不显示） - 侧边栏未读点按标题文本匹配，存在重复标题的会话时两者会共享同一个点（会话管理抽屉内不受影响，按真实会话 id 精确标记） ## 兼容性 本版本在 **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2**（桌面端）验证；上游声明适配 `0.1.1-rc.1` 与 `0.2.0-rc.2`。 已在 0.2.1-rc.2 核对：`ctx.sessionPersistence.locate()` 仍存在；`IconTrashOutline16` 已移除，插件自动回退到 `IconTrashOutlineRegular`；`Modal` / `Button` / `StateDot` 均由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives@0.2.1-rc.2` 导出。 DSH 版本升级后如插槽或服务 API 变化，需要同步适配。 ## 开发 ```sh npm install --no-save tsdown # 仅构建需要，不写入 package.json npx tsdown # 生成 lib/index.js 与 lib/client.js node tests/route-guard.manual.mjs # 路由接管 / 重复挂载回归测试 ``` `lib/` 为提交的构建产物，修改源码后必须重新构建并提交 `lib/`。该工具链在改动前可逐字节复现上游产物。 ## 许可 MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。上游版权归 dream12347；本衍生版本同样以 MIT 发布。

plugins.description: LaTeX compile gate + VTO typesetting loop for DeepSeek Harness: MiKTeX-native, 10 tools, 3 skills, persistent defect ledger, and a Plugins-page configuration form
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-latex-studio

> MiKTeX 原生的 **LaTeX 编译 + VTO（Visual Typesetting Optimization，视觉排版优化）闭环**插件，面向 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）桌面端。
> 两套命令体系：**A 线 日常编译**（`latex_doctor` / `latex_build` / `latex_lint` / `bib_tool`）与 **B 线 VTO 全流程**（`vto_start` / `vto_inspect` / `vto_fix` / `vto_verify` / `vto_report`）。
> 方法学参考 PaperFit（MIT，[arXiv:2605.10341](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10341)），要点见 [docs/paperfit-notes.md](docs/paperfit-notes.md)；模块契约见 [docs/INTERFACES.md](docs/INTERFACES.md)；验收见 [docs/ACCEPTANCE.md](docs/ACCEPTANCE.md)。
>
> 🔧 **维护 / 开发从这里开始：[docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)** —— 架构、工具面、配置契约、维护配方、排错、已知问题，以及历史记录。
> 🧭 **设计依据与取舍**：见 DEVELOPMENT.md §7（关键设计决策与**被否决的方案**）。
>
> ℹ️ **技能由插件自己注册**，装完插件即可用，不需要额外步骤（见 §2.5）。`skills/` 里只有本插件自己的 3 个 `latex-*`；vendor 自 PaperFit 的上游规范自 0.2.0 起只作参考文本（`docs/upstream/paperfit/`），不再注册、不随包发布。

## 1. 它解决什么问题

「编译通过」不等于「可投稿」：孤行寡行、浮动体远离引用、双栏列内空洞、Overfull、表格字号不一等**二维版面缺陷**，只看源码和 `.log` 是看不出来的。
本插件把「**编译 → 读日志 → 渲染页图 → 诊断（18 类缺陷）→ 受限修复 → 门禁复核**」做成可复现的 DSH 工具链：

- **不依赖 latexmk**：MiKTeX 的 latexmk 是 Perl 脚本、需要 Perl（本机没有）。`latex_build` 自研多趟驱动（引擎 → 需要时 bibtex/biber → 直到 `.aux` 稳定，最多 4 趟）。
- **页图后端全部本地、零额外安装**：MiKTeX 自带 Poppler（`pdftoppm`）与 Ghostscript（`mgs.exe`）；MinerU 只作可选兜底。
- **外部件缺失绝不抛异常**：一律降级为 `status:'skipped'` + `advice`（可执行的修复命令）。
- **写操作原子化**：先备份 → 再写 → 用内容守卫校验 → 失败回滚；`vto_fix` 默认 `apply:false` 只给配方与 diff。
- **缺陷台账跨轮持久**：`vto_report({defects:[…]})` 按 `id+page` 落进 `state.json`，`vto_verify` 对「标了 fixed 又复发」判回归、对未清的阻断级缺陷降级 verdict——这是 PaperFit 相对朴素多轮视觉的全部增益来源（显式缺陷记录 + 受限修复 + 门禁）。
- **编译驱动**：默认优先 `latexmk`（带 `.fls` 依赖追踪；需要 Perl，Git 自带亦可），不可用时自动回落内置多趟驱动，两者产出同一结果结构（`via` 标明走了哪条）。
- **隐私内置**：`uploadScope` 闸门统一决定「哪种 PDF 解析可以上传」，默认不外发本人稿件。

## 2. 安装与自检

### 2.1 一条命令（推荐）

```powershell
cd <本仓库>\dsh-latex-studio
node tools/install.mjs              # 打包 → 注册进 profile → 镜像到 node_modules → 自检
```

它会：① `npm pack`（遵守 `files` 白名单，`tools/_p0` 调研证据永远不会进发布集）；
② 备份 profile 清单并登记 bundle；③ 把包树镜像进 `node_modules`（保留已有 `node_modules`）；
④ 用 `tools/doctor.mjs` 验证部署副本，**失败即报错并给出回滚命令**。

参数：`--profile <名字>`（默认 `desktop`）、`--dry-run`（只打印计划，不改任何东西）、
`--no-pack`（复用已打好的 tgz）。

> 安装完会提示 `restart DSH`。**必须重启或开新会话**，新构建才会被加载——正在运行的进程用的仍是旧实例。

### 2.2 自检：`node tools/doctor.mjs`

**装完就该跑一次。** 这个插件最危险的失败模式是"装上了但没加载"，而**没加载的插件无法注册工具
来告诉你它没加载**——所以诊断必须能在插件之外运行：

```powershell
node tools/doctor.mjs                  # 检查当前目录
node tools/doctor.mjs --dir <安装副本>  # 检查别的副本
node tools/doctor.mjs --json           # 机器可读（CI 用）
```

它按顺序回答 5 个问题：**文件齐不齐 → `apply()` 能否注册 10 个工具 + 技能包 → bundle 有没有登记进
profile → 发现根里有没有重复技能（会互相遮蔽）→ 本机 LaTeX 工具链能不能真编译/渲染**。
0.4.0 起还会检查**浏览器半**（`lib/client.js` 的加载器格式与槽位注册）、`locale/` 展示元信息，
并在 `volatile` 行报告本副本解析到的 Schemastery 支持情况（0.4.1 起即使宿主那棵树是旧版，插件也会换用自带的副本，配置页仍可编辑；见 DEVELOPMENT §4.5）。

退出码：`0` 健康｜`1` 有失败项｜`2` 脚本自身出错。本机实测输出：

```
[OK  ] files      28 required files present
[OK  ] patch      inserts the plugin row with no duplicated defaults
[OK  ] tools      10 tools registered: latex_doctor, latex_build, latex_lint, bib_tool,
                  vto_start, vto_inspect, vto_fix, vto_verify, vto_report, vto_rollback
[OK  ] skills     3 skills registered: latex-daily, latex-fix-catalog, latex-vto-loop
[OK  ] volatile   17 config fields are volatile → editable in the Plugins page
[OK  ] client     declares dsh.client (web) and exports ./client
[OK  ] clientBundle lazy-CJS factory, requires react only, registers both config slots
[OK  ] locale     en/zh display metadata present
[OK  ] profile    registered in: desktop
[OK  ] in-sync    this directory IS what profile "desktop" loads
[OK  ] shadows    no discovery root duplicates the plugin-registered skills
[OK  ] toolchain  engine=D:\MiKTeX\miktex\bin\x64\pdflatex.exe (MiKTeX-pdfTeX 4.27 (MiKTeX 26.5))
[OK  ] render     page-image backend: poppler (pdftoppm+pdfinfo)
[OK  ] bib        bibliography tooling: bibtex, biber
verdict: HEALTHY
```

> 如果宿主解析到的是**旧版** schemastery，这一行会变成 `volatile` 的说明 + 一条 `logger` WARN（提示正在使用插件自带的副本），verdict 仍是 HEALTHY——配置页照常可编辑。

### 2.3 手工安装（不用脚本时）

正规通道是**应用内插件管理器**。走命令行时用**桌面端自带的 CLI**：

```powershell
npm pack
& "D:\DshDesktop\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add (Resolve-Path .\dsh-latex-studio-*.tgz)
& "D:\DshDesktop\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin list --profile desktop
```

> ⚠️ 请用上面的**全路径** `dsh.cmd`（默认安装在 `D:\DshDesktop\resources\runtime\cli\bin\`）：
> PATH 上可能还有更早的全局 `dsh`（本机是 **0.1.5-rc.1**），桌面端自带的是 **0.2.1-rc.2**；
> 用错版本操作不到桌面端 profile（见 §9）。
> ⚠️ 本机实测 `dsh plugin add` 在 Electron 独占管理的 profile 上**会挂起**，所以日常请用 §2.1 的脚本。
> 也**不要**用 `--profile desktop --dump-config` 校验（同样被拒绝）。

**从 GitHub 安装（无需构建）**：本仓库直接提交可运行的 `lib/`（纯 JS，没有构建步骤、没有 `prepare` 脚本），
所以 `github:` 安装不需要授权任何构建脚本：

```powershell
& "D:\DshDesktop\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add github:Qingzhu093/dsh-latex-studio
# 建议锁定 commit，避免后续推送悄悄改变实际运行的代码：
& "...\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add github:Qingzhu093/dsh-latex-studio#<sha>
```

### 2.4 升级 / 卸载

```powershell
node tools/install.mjs        # 升级 = 再跑一次（每次自动备份 profile 清单）
node tools/doctor.mjs         # 升级后自检
```

卸载：从 profile 的 `package.json` 删掉 `dependencies` 里的依赖与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里的条目，
再删掉安装副本目录。（清单在 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<名字>/package.json`，`$DSH_HOME` 默认 `~/.dsh`。）

**发布前自证**：`npm run verify:package`（`tools/verify-package.mjs`）会真的 `npm pack` 一份 tarball，
然后逐条断言：白名单没漏进 `docs/`/`tools/_p0/`/`node_modules`、必需文件齐全、`exports` 的每个目标都在包里、
从**解包后的副本**里 `import` 宿主半并跑通 `apply()`（10 工具 + 3 技能）、浏览器半是客户端模块系统要的
lazy-CJS 工厂且只 `require("react")`、零运行时依赖、图标与 locale 元信息合法，最后打印字节数与 sha256。
`doctor` 查"这个目录对不对"，`verify:package` 查"这个包装出去会不会坏"——两者互补。

### 2.5 技能：由插件自己注册（不需要额外步骤）

**装了插件就有技能。** `lib/index.js` 在 `apply()` 里调用 `ctx.skills.register()` 把整包技能
注册出去（**只有本插件自己的 3 个 `latex-*`**：`latex-daily`、`latex-vto-loop`、`latex-fix-catalog`）。
注册是 effect，插件卸载时自动撤销；不需要安装脚本、不需要文件链接、不需要改 profile 配置。

> 0.2.0 起**不再注册 vendored 的上游规范**：那些文本描述的是 PaperFit 的 agent/命令/路径（`data/pages/`、220 DPI、`/check-visual`），注册进来等于让模型拿别人的操作规程当本插件的手册。上游原文保留在 `docs/upstream/paperfit/`（含 MANIFEST 与逐文件哈希）作**只读参考**，`docs/` 也已移出发布白名单。

```js
// lib/index.js（节选）
const service = ctx.get('skills')            // 可选依赖，故意不放进 inject
if (service?.register) registerSkillPack(service, loadSkillPack().skills)
```

> **为什么不能只把文件放进 `skills/`。** DSH 的技能发现只扫描**配置好的根目录**
> （官方 Skills 参考的"本地发现优先级"）：
>
> | rank | source | 根目录 |
> |---|---|---|
> | 100 | `project-dsh` | `<项目根>/.dsh/skills` |
> | 200 | `project-agents` | `<项目根>/.agents/skills` |
> | 300 | `custom` | `Config.customSkillDirs` |
> | 400 | `user-dsh` | `<dshHome>/skills` |
> | 500 | `user-agents` | `<agentsHome>/skills` |
> | 600 | `bundled` | `Config.bundledSkillDir` |
>
> **npm 包自己的 `skills/` 不在其中。** 本项目此前就是这样：3 个 `latex-*` 技能随包发布很久，
> 却一次都没被任何会话发现过。DSH 是围绕插件设计的，插件既然已经装载，就没有理由再绕一圈做文件发现。
>
> `skills` 是**可选**依赖（`ctx.get` 而不是 `inject`）：组合里没有技能服务时，10 个工具照常可用，
> 而不是让插件永远 PENDING——PENDING 的插件连一个工具都注册不了。

**不用插件时怎么读技能**：直接打开 `skills/<名字>/SKILL.md` 即可（例如在编辑器或 CI 里）。
0.2.0 删除了 `tools/install-skills.mjs`：它是为「技能不进上下文」那个已经修好的问题写的兜底，而把同一批技能同时注册又放进发现根，只会互相遮蔽。


### 2.6 环境要求与自助安装（发布版必读）

**硬依赖只有一个：MiKTeX。** 它同时提供引擎、`bibtex`/`biber`/`makeindex`、页图后端（Poppler `pdftoppm`/`pdfinfo`、Ghostscript `mgs.exe`）。其余全部可选，缺了就降级，绝不抛异常。

模型先跑 `latex_doctor`：它逐项报出「已装 / 缺失 + 安装命令」，`advice[]` 里就是可执行命令。对照表：

| Perl + `latexmk` | 可选（推荐） | `.fls` 依赖追踪、正确重跑 | 自动回落内置多趟驱动（结果结构一致，只是没有依赖追踪） | `winget install StrawberryPerl.StrawberryPerl`；或使用 Git 自带的 `<Git>\usr\bin\perl.exe`（探测会自动找到） |
| `chktex` | 可选 | 静态检查的外部通道 | `latex_lint` 少一路信号 | `mpm --install=chktex` |
| 缺宏包 | 按需 | 编译通过 | `latex_build` 报 `File ... not found` | `latex_build` 默认带 `--enable-installer` 自动补装；或 `mpm --install=<pkg>` |
| MinerU / 宿主 `read_pdf` | 可选 | 结构化解析（**可能上传**） | `vto_inspect({parse:true})` 在 `notes` 里说明 | 安装 DSH 的 `dsh-pdf-mineru` 插件 |

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: explain terms first, then render visual cards (PNG) or an offline clickable mermaid page.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-visual-explainer

[![test](https://github.com/biubiuandmiaomiao/dsh-visual-explainer/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/biubiuandmiaomiao/dsh-visual-explainer/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 的讲解插件：**先把专业/技术名词讲成人话，再把讲解画成一张张 PNG 卡片**，或生成一页可点的离线 mermaid 交互页。

图能压缩信息，前提是读者认识图上的词。所以这个插件把顺序固定下来：

1. `visual_terms` 把名词逐个翻成大白话（一个词一句，可带类比与常见误解）；
2. `visual_explain` 才画图，图上的节点/步骤与已解释的名词一一对应；
3. 顺序反了会被**门禁直接拒绝**，而不是悄悄画出一张没人看得懂的图。

![触发链路：一句话 → 技能 → 名词轮 → 出图](docs/screenshots/how-it-works.png)

![门禁实证：没做名词轮就画图会被拒绝](docs/screenshots/terms-first-gate.png)

## 四个工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `visual_terms` | **第 0 轮：先解释名词。** 把本次讲解里的专业/技术名词写成 `{ term, plain, context?, analogy?, pitfall? }`，返回一段可直接放进回答开头的 markdown，并落盘 `terms.md` / `terms.json` |
| `visual_explain` | **再画图。** 写入你给的 HTML，按 `<section id="fgN">` 逐张渲染成 PNG（先测真实高度再截图，图片底部没有多余留白），返回路径 |
| `visual_template` | 可选：写出起步模板（1240px 画布、语义配色、卡片隔离样式、「名词 → 图里在哪」示例卡、测高脚本） |
| `visual_interactive` | 另一种形态：生成**可点的离线交互讲解页**（左侧步骤条 + 右侧 mermaid 图 + 大白话）；`check` 用无头浏览器自检每一步的图能不能渲染 |

渲染走本机 **Chrome / Edge 的 headless 模式**：不装依赖、不联网。插件还注册了一份按需加载的技能手册（`skill.md`），把「把一张图讲成小白能懂」的完整流程与 mermaid 坑位写在其中。

## 真实产物

下面是本插件给 [mem0](https://github.com/mem0ai/mem0) 源码画的 add / search 流程卡片（4 张中的两张）：

![add() 的 8 段流水线](docs/screenshots/example-pipeline.png)

![打分公式与三个坑](docs/screenshots/example-scoring.png)

## 快速开始

### 环境要求

- DeepSeek Harness 桌面版（插件是 host 侧 bundle，在 Windows 上验证；浏览器探测同时覆盖 macOS / Linux 常见路径）
- 本机安装 **Chrome 或 Edge**（渲染与自检都靠它）
- Node.js ≥ 20（跑测试、或独立使用命令行渲染器时需要）

### 安装

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/biubiuandmiaomiao/dsh-visual-explainer.git
cd dsh-visual-explainer
pwsh -File .\install.ps1            # 默认 link：源码改动下次重载生效
# 或：打包成 tgz 再装，和源码目录解耦
pwsh -File .\install.ps1 -Mode pack
```

脚本会自动找 pnpm（`-Pnpm` → `DSH_DESKTOP_PNPM` → DSH 内置运行时 → PATH），并把包选进 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`。

**装完必须重启一次 DeepSeek Harness**：工具在进程启动时注册到 `ctx.tools`。（名词轮的「是否做过」记录是进程内的，重启后第一次画图会重新要求先解释名词——这是有意的。）

验证：

- 侧边栏 **Plugins** 里应能看到 `dsh-visual-explainer` 的开关；
- `%TEMP%\dsh-visual-explainer-status.json` 里 `pluginVersion`、`toolsRegistered`、`appliedAt` 应与本次启动一致；
- 让模型做一次「图解」，它应该能直接调用 `visual_terms`。

<details>
<summary>手动接线（不用 install.ps1）</summary>

在 profile 的 `package.json`（默认 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json`）里：

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-visual-explainer": "file:D:/path/to/dsh-visual-explainer"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "dsh-visual-explainer"]
    }
  }
}
```

然后在 profile 目录执行 `pnpm install`。包内的 `cordis.patch.yml` 会插入插件行，不需要再手写 profile patch（手写过的话要删掉，否则会重复插入）。

</details>

## 配置

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里按行 id 覆盖（也可以直接改包内默认值）：

```yaml
- id: visual-explainer
  name: dsh-visual-explainer
  config:
    outDir: .dsh-visual   # 相对会话工作目录
    scale: 2              # 2 → 1240px 画布输出 2480px 宽
    width: 1240
    browser: ""           # 留空则自动找 Chrome / Edge
    maxCards: 12          # 单次渲染上限，防止误渲染几十张
    termsFirst: true      # true=画图前必须先做名词轮；false=关掉门禁
    explainerDir: .dsh-explain  # visual_interactive 的默认输出目录
```

## 用法（模型侧）

### 直接说

- 「用图解讲讲 X」
- 「一张图看懂 X」
- 「先解释这些名词，再画成图」
- 「把这张时序图讲成代码小白能懂，并做成可点的 mermaid 页」

话术命中技能描述后，模型会按手册顺序调用工具；也可以直接点名工具。

### 四步流水线

```js
// 1. 第 0 轮：名词
visual_terms({
  topic: 'mem0 的 add / search 流程',
  terms: [
    { term: 'Embedding', plain: '把一句话变成一串数字坐标，意思相近的坐标也相近' },
    { term: 'BM25', plain: '老式关键词打分：只认字面，不懂意思' }
  ]
});

// 2. 可选：写起步模板
visual_template({ path: 'explain.html' });

// 3. 出图（HTML 里每张卡是一个 <section id="fgN">，并带上测高脚本）
visual_explain({ html: '<!doctype html>…', outDir: 'figs' });

// 4. 或者：可点的交互页
visual_interactive({ action: 'scaffold', dir: 'explain', title: '看懂这个系统' });
// 改 explain/index.html 里的 const steps=[...]，然后：
visual_interactive({ action: 'check', dir: 'explain' });
// → 自检通过：14/14 张图渲染成功
```

名词轮没做就调 `visual_explain`，会得到明确的错误：

> 先解释名词，再画图：本轮还没有做名词解释（第 0 轮）。

确实没有名词要解释时：`visual_terms({ terms: [], note: '…' })`，或给 `visual_explain` 传 `skipTerms: true`（只建议用于重渲染旧图）。

### 卡片约定

- 一张卡 = 一个结论，id 必须是 `fg1`、`fg2`、`fg3`…（渲染器靠它识别并按编号排序）；
- 高度预算 ≈ 800px，超了就把内容拆到下一张；
- **必须保留测高脚本**（模板里已带）：它把可见 section 的最下沿写进 `document.title`，渲染器据此裁掉底部空白；不要改成 `documentElement.scrollHeight`，内容比视口矮时它会返回视口高度，所有图片都会变成同样尺寸并留白。

## 命令行单独使用（不装 DSH）

```powershell
node renderer.mjs --html explain.html --out figs --scale 2
node renderer.mjs --html explain.html --out figs --figs 1,3   # 只出某几张
node renderer.mjs --html explain.html --out figs --whole      # 整页一张长图
node renderer.mjs --html explain.html --out figs --height 900 # 跳过测高
```

## 交互页（`visual_interactive`）

| 交互 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 左侧步骤条 | 点任意一步换图 + 换解释，当前步高亮并滚动跟随 |
| 上一步 / 下一步 / 自动播放 | 3 秒一步 |
| 键盘 | `←` `→` 切换，`空格` 播放/暂停 |
| 深链 | `index.html#s4` 打开即停在第 4 步 |
| 自检 | `index.html#selftest` 依次渲染全部图并输出结果（`check` 依赖它） |
| 源码折叠 | 每步可展开 mermaid 源码，复制去 mermaid.live |
| 离线 | 自带本地 `mermaid.min.js`，不联网 |

关键限制：**每一步要一张独立的小图**，不要让 mermaid 源码做「增量显示」——`alt` 没闭合会直接 parse 失败；`sequenceDiagram` 每条消息建议 ≤10 个汉字，否则窄泳道会强行断词并插 `-`。

## 目录结构

```
index.js                 # 插件入口：注册 4 个工具 + 技能手册
renderer.mjs             # 卡片渲染：测高 + 逐卡截图（Chrome/Edge headless）
lib/terms.mjs            # 名词轮的解析、去重、markdown 生成、门禁
lib/interactive.mjs      # 交互页 scaffold / 自检
assets/                  # mermaid.min.js、交互页模板
template.html            # visual_template 写出的起步模板
skill.md                 # 插件注册的技能手册
cordis.patch.yml         # bundle patch：插入插件行 + 默认配置
install.ps1              # 安装到 DSH profile
test/                    # node:test 测试（渲染 / 名词轮 / 门禁 / 交互页）
```

## 开发与测试

```powershell
node --check index.js
node --check renderer.mjs
node --check lib/terms.mjs
node --test              # 11 个测试：纯逻辑 + 真渲染
```

`test/render.test.js` 会真的把自带模板渲染到临时目录并校验 PNG 尺寸；`test/interactive.test.js` 会跑一遍页面自检。没有 Chrome/Edge 的机器上，依赖浏览器的测试会自动 skip，纯逻辑测试仍会运行。

CI 在 Ubuntu / Windows × Node 20 / 22 上跑同一套测试（见 [.github/workflows/test.yml](.github/workflows/test.yml)）。

## 故障排查

| 现象 | 检查 |
|---|---|
| 工具列表里没有 `visual_terms` / `visual_explain` | 重启 Harness；读 `%TEMP%\dsh-visual-explainer-status.json`：没有 `appliedAt` → 插件没加载；`toolsRegistered.visual_terms=false` → 看 `termsRegisterError` |
| 画图时报「先解释名词，再画图」 | 正常门禁：先调 `visual_terms`；确实没有名词就用 `terms: []` + `note`；旧图重渲染用 `skipTerms: true` |
| `visual_terms` 报「缺少 plain」 | 名词轮不允许只罗列名词：每个词补一句大白话 |
| 渲染失败 / 0 张图 | 状态文件的 `lastFailures`；多为找不到浏览器（设 `browser` 或 `CHROME_PATH`）或 HTML 里没有 `id="fgN"` |
| 每张图尺寸都一样且底部留白 | 测高脚本被改成了 `scrollHeight` |
| 多张卡挤进一张图 | 卡片隔离样式被删，或 id 不是 `fgN` |
| 中文变方框 | 用模板里的字体栈，别引入未安装的 web 字体 |
| 交互页白屏 | 必须用 `scaffold` 生成的页面（本地 `mermaid.min.js`）；不要从 CDN 引 |

## 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 biubiuandmiaomiao

打包的 `assets/mermaid.min.js` 是 [Mermaid](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid)（MIT）的浏览器构建，用于离线渲染交互页；完整的第三方声明与许可证文本见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

plugins.description: Two-checklist guardrail for DeepSeek Harness: hard safety blocks + soft gap hints. Windows & Linux rule sets, 15/15 checks pass.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-guardrail

双清单哨兵（guardrail sentinel）for DeepSeek Harness — a guardrail plugin with
two checklists: a hard safety list (secrets, system paths, dangerous writes,
governance-file writes, firewall/credential operations — stop and report on
hit) and a soft gaps list (rollback/acceptance gaps, key-usage hints,
three-questions receipt, "no evidence, not done" — suggestions only, never
scores, never rules).

## Status

Alpha, in development. Spec first, implementation second: the behavior contract
comes from a running multi-agent system in which the same double-checklist
guard already operates as a platform agent. This plugin ports that contract
into a DSH bundle. No silent acceptance: on a safety hit the plugin pauses the
task instead of passing it through.

## Install (once published)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/weft-audit/dsh-guardrail
```

## Contract

1. Hard list (stop): secret patterns; writes outside the workspace
   (Windows/system dirs, registry, firewall); destructive recursive deletes;
   writes to governance files (AGENTS.md / 公共件.md / 目标.md / 个人事实.md /
   红线*); reading .credentials files; Defender policy changes; printing keys;
   Linux hazards (iptables/nft flush, firewalld/ufw disable, sudoers writes,
   /etc/hosts·passwd·shadow·sudoers·sshd_config paths, dd to /dev/sd*).
2. Soft list (advise): missing rollback point, undefined acceptance criteria,
   key-usage hint, three-questions receipt unanswered, and a `tools/result`
   check that flags "done/success" claims without evidence marks
   (【命令】/【原始输出】).
3. Output shape: `{ hard: [...], soft: [...] }`, each at most 8 lines.

## Rules honored

The plugin never scores and never rules. The human (or the main auditor) is
the only arbiter. The "three questions" (rules changed? key used? firewall
touched?) are asked by the platform-side micro-auditor; this plugin only marks
them as unanswered — it never interrogates other agents.

plugins.description: 目录插件：让 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端「新建工作区」的文件夹选择框从你设定的默认目录开始（Windows）｜Start the DSH new-workspace folder picker in your own directory.
