- Only the first 100 repositories are read (sorted by recent update); there is no pagination yet.
- Without a token, `/users/:name/repos` returns public repositories owned by that account. Organization and collaborator repositories require a token and `/user/repos`.
- A mirror page is only as fresh as the mirror; it may lag behind GitHub.
- Fetched repository data comes from the GitHub REST API. The panel is a launcher, not a full GitHub client.

## Development

```text
client.js         Browser bundle (plain CJS factory registered with window.__ModuleLoader__)
index.js          Empty host half; gives the bundle a Loader entry
cordis.patch.yml  Inserts the github-mirror entry
package.json      DSH client declaration and package metadata
```

There is no bundler or build step. After editing `client.js`, DSH's client module system reloads it by file revision; refresh the page if needed.

Useful checks:

```bash
node --check client.js
node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('package.json','utf8'))"
```

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for the manual test checklist.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面的电源按钮：在对话标题中点击一个小对话框，提示“重启 DSH 或退出 DSH”——每个对话框都会再次确认，之后才会进行任何操作。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-powerbox

A power button for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) Web UI: one click in the conversation header opens a small dialog offering **Restart DSH** or **Quit DSH** — and each of those asks for confirmation again before anything happens.

**[中文说明 →](README.zh-CN.md)**

![Header power button](docs/screenshot-header.png)

The two-step flow — pick an action, then confirm it:

![Restart or quit, each behind a confirmation](docs/screenshot.png)

---

## Why

Restarting or quitting DSH normally means reaching for the tray icon / title bar and hunting through menus. That is awkward when the window is in the foreground and you are mid-session. This plugin puts both actions where you already are looking: the top-right of the conversation header.

Because both actions are destructive — restarting kills in-flight tool calls, quitting closes the app — the flow is deliberately two-step:

```
[⏻]  →  Choose an action  →  Restart DSH / Quit DSH
                            ↓
                         Confirm  →  act
```

`Cancel`, `Esc` and clicking the backdrop all exit without touching anything.

## Requirements

- DSH with the Web UI (`dsh --profile <name>`), version 0.2 or newer.
- A desktop shell that exposes `window.dshDesktop` for the power actions. In a plain browser the button renders **disabled** with an explanatory tooltip instead of half-working.
  - Restart calls `dshDesktop.boot.restart()`.
  - Quit calls `dshDesktop._call('win.close-force', {})`.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:AsterLuo/dsh-powerbox
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so the official CLI appends `dsh-powerbox` to `dsh.profile.bundles` on its own. **You do not need to edit `cordis.patch.yml` or `package.json` by hand.** Restart DSH (or reload the Web UI) and the button appears in the conversation header.

Using an older CLI that does not reconcile bundles? Then add the row manually to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: powerbox
      name: 'dsh-powerbox'
```

## Uninstall

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> remove dsh-powerbox
```

If you added the patch row by hand, delete it as well. Restart DSH afterwards.

## How it works

| Piece | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the plugin row into the composed profile (this is what makes it load). |
| `lib/index.js` | Host half. Intentionally a no-op — it only exists so the package is a valid bundle (the loader requires `name` + `apply`). |
| `lib/client.js` | Everything else: the header button, the mode dialog, both confirmation dialogs, and the bridge calls. |

The client half registers one entry in the `conversation.session.header.utilities` slot (a `list` slot, session scope — the same one the official *Open in app* action uses), which is what places the button at the right end of the conversation header.

- No build step. It is a hand-written `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` bundle, exactly like the built-in plugins.
- No runtime dependencies. `react` is provided by the host through the module loader.
- Styling uses only `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens, so it follows light and dark themes.

### Safety details

- The confirm button disables itself while the request is in flight, and a synchronous re-entry guard makes a second call impossible even if the click is dispatched programmatically.
- `Esc` closes the dialog — except while an action is running, so you cannot hide a restart you already triggered.
- Focus returns to the power button when the dialog closes.
- Failures are reported in the dialog with a retry path, never swallowed.

## Development

```bash
npm install
npm test        # node --test, jsdom-backed
npm run check   # syntax check both halves
```

The tests drive the real plugin bundle in a jsdom window with a recording `window.dshDesktop` stub. `react` is replaced by a small hook-compatible stub (see `test/harness.mjs`), because the real one is supplied by the host at runtime and is not a dependency of this package. Covered: slot registration contract, the full click-through of both flows, "no bridge call before the second confirmation", exactly-one-call, in-flight disabling, `Esc`, backdrop, focus restore, missing-bridge degradation, error surfacing, and the package/patch metadata that the installer relies on.

## License

MIT © AsterLuo

plugins.description: A local background-task board for AI coders: inspect launchd jobs and hand context to an Agent in DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# Always-on Board

**AI Coder 的本机后台任务与 Agent 协同看板。**

看清后台还在跑什么，决定是否保留，再把任务上下文交给 Agent 排查。

[English](README.en.md) · [安装](#快速开始) · [四步使用示意](docs/tour.md)

## 为什么需要它

AI 帮你启动了 API、worker、定时脚本和开发服务。项目越做越多，后台也越积越多：哪个还在运行？哪个已经失败？这个任务属于什么项目，还需要留着吗？

Always-on Board 把常驻任务和运行进程放在一起，让你看状态、读用途，再决定下一步。

![个人项目的 API、看板服务，以及 Remotion、Blender MCP、Code Review MCP 运行进程组](docs/images/05-real-public-tasks.png)

*真实采集数据节选：3 个个人项目任务、3 个进程组，在隔离 DSH 中渲染。仅展示选定条目，已去除私人路径、主机信息和会话侧栏；用途注释沿用原截图。*

## 你做决定，Agent 带着上下文排查

- **面向用户（User Facing）**：查看任务用途、状态和监听端口，发现可能失效或遗忘的服务。支持中文 / English。
- **面向 Agent（Model Facing）**：通过结构化快照和对话草稿交接任务身份、配置或项目线索，让 Agent 有据可查，而不必从零猜测。

协同流程很简单：**查看任务 → 右键选择意图 → 检查并发送草稿 → Agent 排查 → 刷新并验证实际结果**。

| 右键操作 | 交给 Agent 的请求 |
| --- | --- |
| 解释 | 只读说明用途、来源及是否需要保留 |
| 修复 | 检查故障，确认启动方式，修复并验证结果 |
| 停用 | 先说明影响，确认范围，保留配置和数据 |
| 补齐说明 | 读取配置和脚本，补一句用途；仅在适用任务缺少说明时出现 |

看板只准备草稿，**由你检查并发送**。后续操作遵循 Agent 宿主的权限机制；看板不直接修复、停止或重启任务。

## 快速开始

需要 **macOS + DeepSeek Harness（DSH）**，宿主须支持本地 bundle、侧边栏和会话草稿接口。已在 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 验证相关 UI，最低兼容版本尚未建立。

### CLI 安装到 Web profile

已安装 DSH CLI 的用户可以在终端执行：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:caizhidian-ops/always-on-board"
```

安装完成后启动 `dsh web`；如果 Web profile 已在运行，保存当前工作并重新启动该实例，再从侧边栏打开 **Always-on Board**。

如需固定经过验证的源码版本：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:caizhidian-ops/always-on-board#8c4246eb75bbc4b2e6b723d81c4b5c65da7324bc"
```

两条命令已在 macOS、Node.js 22、DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 的独立临时 `DSH_HOME` 中验证：下载和安装成功、bundle 自动加入 Web profile、配置合成包含 `ops-board`，宿主模块可加载。此项验证不包含从该临时配置重新进行 UI 或模型调用验收，详见[安装验证记录](docs/cli-install-verification.md)。

`web` 是安装目标 profile。CLI 的 `desktop` profile 由桌面应用管理，不能直接把命令里的 `web` 换成 `desktop`；桌面用户可使用下方本地 bundle 方式。无需发布到 npm，也无需为这个直接运行 JavaScript 的插件添加构建脚本。

卸载 Web profile 中的插件：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @local/dsh-ops-board
```

该命令中的内部包名保留旧标识。卸载看板不会停止其观察的任务；本地用途说明也不会随之删除。

### 本地 bundle 安装

```sh
git clone https://github.com/caizhidian-ops/always-on-board.git
cd always-on-board
```

在 DSH 插件管理器中安装本地 bundle，指向仓库的绝对路径。支持 `plugin_manager` 的环境可使用：

```text
install_bundle target=/absolute/path/to/always-on-board
```

启用后，从侧边栏打开 **Always-on Board**。先创建一个 Workspace，再使用右键草稿。保留源码目录；更新时运行 `git pull --ff-only`，再通过插件管理器重新加载。

## 范围与隐私

- 观察本机配置的后台任务和当前用户的部分开发运行时，不覆盖全部进程，也不能判断是否由 AI 创建。
- 页面每 15 秒刷新。状态、进程存在和端口只是排查线索，不代表业务健康；没有耗电测量或自动清理。
- 插件不自带遥测或云端上传；首次使用可能创建本地用途说明模板。快照仍可能含路径、主机名和敏感参数，不要公开原始快照或日志。
- 发送草稿及日志后的数据处理取决于 DSH 和所选模型提供方。任务内容是证据，不是修改系统的授权。

[技术参考与 JSON 接口](docs/reference.zh.md) · [开发与贡献](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [安全说明](SECURITY.md) · [截图生成与脱敏](docs/screenshots/README.md)

## 许可

[MIT License](LICENSE)

plugins.description: DSH agent preset: confirm the requirement with a questionnaire before executing.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-preset-requirement-confirm

[中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-preset-requirement-confirm.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-preset-requirement-confirm)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

一个「先确认、后执行」的 DSH Agent 预设：模型先把需求拆成子需求，用一次问卷逐题确认（选项、多选、手动填写、每题带通俗解释），你提交之后才开始执行。

这个包是一个组合包，包含两半：

- **Agent 预设（host）**：插入一行 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset`，预设选择器里出现 **需求确认**。它同时通过 `./tool` 注册 `ask_user_question` 工具，schema 多一个每题可选的 `detail`。
- **浏览器样式（client）**：把每题的说明文本左右内缩 24px，与题目标题对齐，并使用选项释义的灰色。

> 目标客户端：DSH 桌面端 **0.2.1-rc.1 / 0.2.1-rc.2**。

**用法**：用这个模式新建会话 → 描述任务 → 回答模型发来的问卷并提交。模型只在提交后执行；需要授权的操作会在审批面板显示模型写的 `justification`。

## 安装

1. 客户端侧边栏 → **插件** → **添加插件**。
2. 填 `dsh-preset-requirement-confirm@1.3.0`（或选择本地源码目录）。
3. **安装** → **立即启用**；若提示「改动在下次启动生效」，重启客户端。
4. 新建会话，在预设选择器里选 **需求确认**。

## 使用

1. 描述一个包含多个方面的任务。
2. 模型调用 `ask_user_question`：每题显示一段说明（`detail`）、若干选项（含 **以上皆可**）以及手动填写入口。
3. 你提交后模型才开始执行。
4. 需要你授权的操作，审批面板会显示模型写的 `justification`。

## 与出厂 `standard` 预设的差异

对齐 0.2.1-rc.1 / rc.2 的 `standard` 组合，只做两处改动：

- persona 的 `prefix` 增加四步工作流（拆解 → 问卷 → 等待确认 → 授权说明）；
- 禁用出厂的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user` 行，由本包的 `./tool` 注册**同名**工具，schema 多一个可选的 `detail` 字段。

其余行与 `standard` 完全一致（persona、agent-instructions、time-context、bash/pwsh、fs、jobs、schedule、skill、goal、计划模式、压缩、委派与 workflow-ptc、todo、web、present、plugin-manager、plugin-market）。

同名注册是刻意的：问卷卡片与工具行靠 `ask_user_question` 这个名字关联，改名会破坏「关闭卡片后从工具行重新打开」等集成。

## 为什么需要浏览器半区

出厂问卷卡片（`dsh-client-ui-user-questions`）把每题的 `detail` 渲染成卡片滚动区里第一个不带 `role` 的子元素，但样式只给它 `margin: 0 2px 8px`，没有左右内边距，于是说明文本贴着卡片边缘，而标题内缩了 24px。

浏览器半区注入一条规则：

```css
[data-question-scroll] > div:first-child:not([role]) {
  margin-inline: 0;
  padding-inline: 24px;
  color: var(--dsw-alias-label-tertiary);
}
```

选择器锚定结构而不是 class 名：CSS Module 的 class 名每次构建都会变，而 `data-question-scroll`、不带 `role` 的说明块、带 `role` 的选项块是稳定的。没有 `detail` 的题目，第一个子元素就是选项块（带 `role`），因此规则不会误伤。样式节点挂在插件 fiber 上，禁用或重载时自动移除。

## 已知限制

- **选择器依赖卡片结构。** 如果未来客户端去掉 `data-question-scroll` 或调整子元素顺序，样式会静默失效，但不会破坏布局。
- **只影响通用问卷卡片。** 计划评审卡、已作答回放卡不使用 `data-question-scroll`。
- **预设是软约束。** 模型仍可能跳过问卷；需要硬性拦截时请配合沙箱与审批策略。
- **审批说明不是独立折叠区。** 插件通过 persona 要求模型写清楚 `justification`，不修改客户端。

## 兼容性

目标客户端 **0.2.1-rc.2**。全部 JavaScript 都不 import `@deepseek-ai/*`：host 半区只用 `ctx.tools.register()` 与 `ctx.userQuestions.ask()`，client 半区只用浏览器模块加载器与 DOM。

## 目录结构

```
dsh-preset-requirement-confirm/
├── package.json         # dsh.bundle.patch（host 补丁）+ dsh.client（浏览器半区）
├── cordis.patch.yml     # 预设声明 + bundle 级行
├── lib/index.js         # bundle 行 host 半区：惰性
├── lib/tool.js          # 预设行：注册带 detail 的 ask_user_question
├── lib/client.js        # 浏览器半区：说明文本对齐与配色
└── README.md
```

## 卸载

在 **插件** 里禁用或移除该组合包，然后重启客户端。

## 开发

```powershell
node --check lib/index.js
node --check lib/tool.js
node --check lib/client.js
node tools/validate.mjs
```

## 许可

MIT。与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系。

plugins.description: Region screenshot for the DeepSeek Harness composer: hides the DSH window, drag a rectangle over anything behind it, annotate, and drop the PNG into the composer. Windows.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-screenshot

**Region screenshot for the DeepSeek Harness composer.**

One row in the composer's `+` menu. Click it, pick a mode, the DSH window steps aside, a
native selection form covers the whole desktop, you drag a rectangle over the part you
actually wanted, annotate it, press the green tick — and the PNG lands in the composer as a
**pending attachment**, ready to send with your next message.

English | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

---

## What you get

| Action | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Composer `+` → **Screenshot** | Opens the two-mode picker |
| **Hide this window, then capture** | DSH is parked first, so the shot shows what is behind it |
| **Keep this window visible** | DSH stays on screen and can be part of the crop |
| Drag on the frozen desktop | Selection rectangle, over the **whole** virtual screen at 1:1 |
| Drag a white grip | Resize the selection (8 grips, min 6×6) |
| Drag anywhere inside the frame (or the inner border strip) | Move the selection |
| `Ctrl`+drag inside the frame | Draw a rectangle annotation |
| `Ctrl+Z` / ↶ button | Undo the last mark |
| `Enter` / green ✓ | Accept and drop the PNG in the composer |
| `Esc` / red ✕ / right click | Cancel |

The chosen mode is remembered in `localStorage` under `dsh-screenshot.mode`.

## Why the selection is native, not in the page

The picker used to be a DOM overlay. It could never be correct: a renderer's viewport is the
app window, so the overlay was confined to the window rectangle and the frozen desktop had to
be scaled down to fit inside it. You could only ever frame a region on a picture of the
screen, not on the screen.

A WinForms form parented to nothing, sized to `SystemInformation.VirtualScreen` and marked
topmost, covers every monitor at 1:1. That is where the framing, the eight grips, the move
strip and the annotation toolbar live now. The client half only hands the result over.

Two things follow, and both are deliberate:

- **The window is only away while you frame it.** The park/restore pair is a `try/finally`
  around the selector, so cancelling, timing out, or an exception all put DSH back.
- **One coordinate space.** Pointer positions, the crop and the saved PNG are all in real
  screen pixels, because there is no `object-fit: contain` scaling step to invert.

The handle is also written to a record file before the window is parked, and
`scripts\snip.ps1 -RestoreOnly` can pull it back if the process was killed outright.

## Requirements

- **Windows 10/11.** Parking a window and drawing over the desktop are Win32 calls. There is
  no macOS or Linux path.
- A DSH desktop build whose composer exposes the `commandUi` service and the
  `webServer` + `connection` host services (the shipping desktop profile does).
- Windows PowerShell 5.1, which ships with Windows. Nothing else to install — the C#
  selector is compiled on demand by `Add-Type`.

## Install

The plugin is a plain DSH bundle: `package.json` + host half (`index.js`) + client half
(`client.js`) + `cordis.patch.yml` + the native selector in `scripts/`.

1. Clone it somewhere outside the profile:

   ```powershell
   git clone https://github.com/Dcmwfg/dsh-screenshot.git E:\dsh-plugins\dsh-screenshot
   ```

2. In `<profile>/package.json` (on Windows that is
   `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json`) add the dependency:

   ```json
   "dependencies": { "dsh-screenshot": "link:E:/dsh-plugins/dsh-screenshot" }
   ```

3. Add the bundle name to the same file:

   ```json
   "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["...", "dsh-screenshot"] } }
   ```

4. Link it into the profile's `node_modules`:

   ```powershell
   New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-screenshot" `
     -Target "E:\dsh-plugins\dsh-screenshot"
   ```

5. **Restart DSH.** New bundles are composed at boot; editing files afterwards takes effect
   on the next start.

A junction (rather than a copy) means edits to the checkout are live after a restart.

## Usage

1. Open the composer's `+` menu. The row is called **Screenshot** and sits right after
   **File** — the host hard-codes its Add section as `file/goal/plan/feedback` and pushes
   every other contribution into the Commands section, so this plugin re-sorts its own row
   once to sit next to File.
2. Pick a mode. The picker remembers the last choice.
3. The desktop freezes under a dim veil. Drag the region, adjust it with the grips (a plain
   drag inside the frame moves it, `Ctrl`+drag marks it), annotate
   if you want.
4. Press `Enter` or the green tick.
5. The image appears above the input box as a draft. Typing and pressing Enter sends it.

Nothing is sent until you submit — the screenshot is an attachment, not a message.

## How it is built

| Half | File | Job |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Host | `index.js` | `POST /dsh-shot/shot` → spawns PowerShell with `scripts/snip.ps1`, answers one finished PNG as a data URL. `GET /dsh-shot/ping` is a liveness probe. |
| Client | `client.js` | Registers the `shot` command with its two modes, waits for the picker sheet to close, fires the capture, and drops the returned PNG into the composer. |
| Native | `scripts/snip.ps1` + `scripts/DshShot.cs` | Park the window (optional) → blit the virtual screen → topmost full-screen selector (frame, grips, move, annotate) → crop composite → save PNG → restore. Also restores on demand with `-RestoreOnly`. |

Both routes go through `ctx.connection.requestRejection(req)`, so they inherit the host's
normal request policy instead of opening an unauthenticated hole.

### HTTP surface

| Route | Method | Body | Answer |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `/dsh-shot/shot` | `POST` | `{"title": string, "hide": boolean}` | `{"ok":true,"dataUrl":"data:image/png;base64,…","width":W,"height":H,"restored":true,"bytes":N}` or `{"ok":false,"reason":"cancelled"\|"failed","message":"…"}` |
| `/dsh-shot/ping` | `GET` | — | `{"ok":true,"driver":"…","shell":"…"}` |

The body is capped at 4 KB and the selector at 180 s. `title` is matched against window
captions to find the window to park; when nothing matches, the capture fails instead of
guessing at whatever happens to be in front. `width`/`height` are the **cropped** size, not
the desktop size.

### Why a synthetic `drop` event

The composer accepts files through the document-level drop listener that
`dsh-client-ui-attachment` installs (`installDocumentDropEvents`). Dispatching one
`DragEvent('drop')` with a real `DataTransfer` therefore rides the exact same upload and
preview path as a human drag-and-drop, without reaching into composer internals that move
between releases.

### Why the sheet is polled

The host's `PopupSelectController` sets `submitting`, awaits `onSelect`, and only then
closes the sheet. So `onSelect` here returns immediately and the capture is fired from a
poll that waits for the sheet to leave the DOM — otherwise "keep this window visible" would
freeze the picker panel into the frame. The poll gives up after 1.5 s and shoots anyway.

## Self-test

```powershell
node --check index.js
node --check client.js

# Fixed region, window left visible: prints one JSON line and writes a PNG
powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -STA -ExecutionPolicy Bypass `
  -File scripts\snip.ps1 -OutPath "$env:TEMP\shot.png" -AutoSelect '200,150,800,500' -HideWindow 0

# Park the window, shoot, and put it back
powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -STA -ExecutionPolicy Bypass `
  -File scripts\snip.ps1 -OutPath "$env:TEMP\shot2.png" -AutoSelect '100,100,640,360' `
  -HideWindow 1 -TitleFragment 'DeepSeek Harness' -Record "$env:TEMP\shot2.parked"

# Safety net, if a capture was killed mid-way
powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -STA -ExecutionPolicy Bypass `
  -File scripts\snip.ps1 -RestoreOnly -Record "$env:TEMP\shot2.parked"
```

Expected: one JSON line with `"ok":true` and `"width":800,"height":500` for the first
command (the crop size, not the desktop size). `-AutoSelect` skips the selector, so this
runs headless. `"restored":true` from the third command means the window came back.

Without `-AutoSelect` the same script opens the real selector and blocks until you confirm
or press `Esc`; a cancel answ

plugins.description: LAN session sync for DSH: auto-discover devices running this plugin, browse/pull/push sessions over HTTP with SHA-256 verification, and keep a local-only nickname per device. ｜ DSH 局域网会话同步：自动发现装了本插件的设备、仅存本机的设备命名、浏览/拉取/推送会话，带 SHA-256 校验。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-sync **LAN session sync for DSH.** Every DSH that has this plugin discovers the others on the local network, lists their sessions, and can pull or push conversations over plain HTTP. The nickname you give a device lives **only on your machine** — the peer can go offline, reboot, or change IP and come back, and you still see the name you gave it.
[![CI](https://github.com/XXGxiaoyu/dsh-session-sync/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/XXGxiaoyu/dsh-session-sync/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/XXGxiaoyu/dsh-session-sync)](https://github.com/XXGxiaoyu/dsh-session-sync/stargazers) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT) [![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.1--rc.2-4d6bfe)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh) 🌏 [简体中文](./README_ZH.md) · **English**
![Session Sync panel](docs/preview.png) ## ✨ Features | | | |---|---| | **📡 Zero-config discovery**
UDP broadcast on every IPv4 interface with a 4s beacon. A peer that just appeared gets an immediate unicast reply, so new devices show up without waiting for the next round. | **🏷️ Local-only nicknames**
Stored in `/session-sync/state.json` and keyed by a stable **device id** (uuid) — not IP, not hostname. The peer renaming itself never overwrites your label. | | **🗂️ Browse · pull · push**
See each device's sessions with title, cwd and time; pull one into this machine or push one of yours out. Imported rows are marked as pulled. | **🔐 SHA-256 verification**
Exports carry `sha256 = SHA-256(JSON.stringify({format, session, events}))`; imports compare it **before writing a byte** and refuse with HTTP 409 `checksum-mismatch`. Each row has a *Verify* action. | | **🔁 Optional auto-pull**
Every 20s, pull sessions you have not pulled yet. Content fingerprints (not ids) stop two machines with auto-pull on from bouncing one conversation back and forth forever. | **🎨 Native look, i18n**
Built from DSH design tokens (colors, radii, type scale, 0.2s transitions), so light/dark follow the host. Language follows DSH by default, with explicit 中文 / English overrides. | | **🖱️ Drag, select, drop**
Select one or many sessions and drag them onto any known folder — every drop asks for confirmation and names the folder the conversation will be imported into. | **🚦 Confirmed transfer queue**
Repeated pushes/pulls are detected up front; a dialog lets you keep the local copy, overwrite it, or drop that single item. The rest of the queue keeps running in order. | | **⚡ One-click sync**
**Sync all** / **Push all** plan the whole device in one go, skip sessions already present by content fingerprint, and report each row as done, skipped or failed. | **🌐 Cross-subnet scanning**
Broadcast stays on the local segment; add CIDRs, IPs or `ip:port` under *Cross-subnet scan*. CIDRs get silent UDP discovery packets, single IPs are also probed over HTTP on 47802–47817 — a firewall that drops UDP no longer hides the peer. | ### Three UI promises - **“This device” is always the first row, and one IP is never two devices.** The card shows this machine's name, `LAN address:sync port` and running version. Any peer whose address belongs to this host is grouped underneath it as “other DSH instances on this machine” (browsable and pushable, so cross-profile sync still works) instead of counting as a device — the list and its counters only ever mean **other machines**. - **Untitled sessions carry `#first-8-chars-of-session-id`.** A pile of “Untitled” rows looks identical; the id is what tells them apart. The pull plan's “already present” flag is keyed by the same peer + session id, so renaming a session never turns a duplicate into a fresh copy. - **A crashing UI is never blank.** Render errors hit an error boundary that prints platform, Node version, host version, ports, UA and a stack summary, with *Reload* / *Copy diagnostics*. If Windows still shows nothing, paste that block into an issue. ## 🚀 Installation ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:XXGxiaoyu/dsh-session-sync ``` Requires DSH **0.2.1-rc.2** (the version bundled with the current desktop app) and Node 22+. Then restart the DSH desktop app (host-side changes load at boot; open pages pick up the new UI on refresh). The page footer shows the build that is actually running — if it reads an older number than the latest release, the process has not been restarted yet. The install is auto-activated: the package declares `dsh.bundle`, so `dsh plugin add` adds it to `dsh.profile.bundles` on its own. Prebuilt tarball (no build step):
Manual install from a local checkout ```jsonc // ~/.dsh/profiles//package.json { "dependencies": { "dsh-session-sync": "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-session-sync" }, "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-session-sync"] } } } ``` ```sh cd ~/.dsh/profiles/ && pnpm install ```
Confirm it loaded — the log shows: ```text [dsh-session-sync] ready: device , sync port 47802, discovery port 47801 [dsh-session-sync] discovered (192.168.1.7:47802) ``` ## 🧭 Where it lives A **Session Sync** row appears under **Plugins** in the left sidebar (`sidebar.panellist` + keyed `main` panel, id `session-sync`). The same component is also registered as **Settings → Session Sync** (`settings.section`). - **This machine** — the name other devices see; changing it broadcasts immediately. - **Devices** — online/offline, last heartbeat, session count, platform and version. - **Rename / Forget** — a per-device nickname for this machine only. Offline devices keep their row (and their nickname), greyed out. - **Sessions / Pull / Push** — list a peer's sessions, copy one here, or send one over. - **Verify** — re-fetch the peer's payload, recompute SHA-256 and compare it with the local copy (`sha256 2b12f7854d80… verified`). - **Sync settings** — UI language, auto-pull, and manual peer addresses for networks where broadcast is blocked (`ip` or `ip:udpPort`, one per line). ## 🌏 UI language | Option | Behavior | | --- | --- | | Follow DSH (default) | Use DSH's current language. DSH already resolves the system language, so non-Chinese systems get English, Chinese systems get Chinese | | 中文 | Always Chinese | | English | Always English | ```text settings.locale = 'auto' | 'zh' | 'en' // persisted in /session-sync/state.json ``` The plugin reads `ctx.locale.getSnapshot().active` (`zh*` → Chinese, everything else → English) and only falls back to `navigator.languages` when no locale service exists. A language change is written to disk **before** the UI switches, so it never reverts on the next open. Sidebar/settings labels are resolved by the host, so the plugin re-registers its slots when the language changes — the page and the sidebar row never disagree. ![English UI](docs/preview-en.png) ## 🎨 Look and motion The UI uses DSH's own CSS variables rather than copied hex values: `--dsw-alias-*` for colors, `--dsw-radius-*`, the `--dsw-font-*` scale, and `var(--ds-transition-duration) var(--ds-ease-in-out)` for every transition. Layout follows the built-in settings pages — title + muted note on the left, control on the right, `.5px` dividers, 32px inputs/selects, 36×22 pill switches — so it stays consistent in both themes and in narrow windows. ## ⚙️ Configuration (loader row `config`) | Key | Default | Meaning | | --- | --- | --- | | `name` | hostname | Initial display name (the GUI value wins afterwards) | | `lanPort` | `47802` | Sync HTTP port; tries the next 16 ports when busy | | `discoveryPort` | `47801` | UDP discovery port | | `token` | none | If set, LAN HTTP calls must send `x-dsh-session-sync-token` | | `home` | `$DSH_HOME` or `~/.dsh` | Root for state and sessions | | `autoPullIntervalMs` | `20000` | Auto-pull interval (lowered in tests) | | `verbos

plugins.description: Ultracode mode for DeepSeek Harness — dynamic workflows, a composer switch, and a live workflow sidebar.
plugins.readme_text:
# Ultracode **Dynamic workflows for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).** Ultracode is a session mode that turns every substantive task into a multi-agent workflow. Arm it once; the agent scopes the work, writes a `workflow` script, fans out subagents in phases, verifies adversarially, and synthesizes the result. [![test](https://github.com/Big-Smarty/dsh-ultracode/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Big-Smarty/dsh-ultracode/actions/workflows/test.yml) [![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) ## Screenshots

The overview block, a live run, and a finished run.

![Ultracode beside a DeepSeek Harness session](docs/images/session.png) *The Ultracode tab in context.* ![A workflow running in the transcript](docs/images/run.png) *The workflow tool's run card.* ## Features - **Session mode, not a model setting.** `/ultracode [on|off|status]` arms one session. The stance is folded from the command log, so resume, fork, and replay restore it. - **Workflow-first policy.** While armed, a prompt section after the `workflow` tool's own guidance classifies work as substantive or trivial, requires phases and `pipeline`/`parallel` fan-out, isolates writers, adds adversarial verification, and asks for evidence in the report. - **Composer switch.** A quiet bordered pill when off; a flat accent tint and dot when armed, plus a thin seam along the composer edge. No gradients, no icon glyphs. - **Workflow sidebar.** The `ULTRA` badge opens a right-sidebar ledger: running and finished runs, phase cards with progress rails and dots, per-agent status, model, tokens, and wall time, verification tags, a high-fan-out marker, and child-transcript drill-down. - **Answers from the log.** No new session-event types. One projection folds `/ultracode` command lifecycles; another folds `tool-workflow/*` records and closes runs abandoned by interrupted or forked turns. Phases keep their raw identity; cancelled outcomes stay distinct from failures. - **No build step, no dependencies.** Plain ESM and browser JavaScript, host theme tokens, English and Chinese copy. ## Preset compatibility Ultracode is a stance, not a preset. It needs the preset's `workflow` tool. | Preset | `workflow` tool | Ultracode behavior | |---|---|---| | Standard | yes | Full policy, phases, subagents, verification, and ledger. | | Creator (`cordis`) | yes | Full; Standard's tools plus plugin-authoring tools. | | PTC | no; only `run_code` and its SDK | Policy suppressed. The overview reports **Workflow unavailable in this preset**; no workflow runs. PTC can call subagents as SDK bindings, but that is code-level PTC, not a tracked Ultracode workflow. | | Minimal | no; persistent shell + `read_image` | UI-only. The complete persona also suppresses the policy; the overview reports **Workflow unavailable in this preset**. | | Custom | depends on its composition | Full when it composes `workflow-ptc` and `tool-workflow`; otherwise the policy is suppressed. | The policy checks whether `workflow` is model-visible for the agent. The overview warning recognizes the built-in `minimal` and `ptc` presets; a custom preset without workflow gets the suppressed policy but no preset-name warning. ## Install Requires DeepSeek Harness with the `workflow` tool and the Web/Desktop right sidebar. Tested with **0.2.1-rc.2**; nearby versions with the same services should work. ### From GitHub 1. Open **Plugins** in the DSH sidebar. 2. Choose **Add plugin** → **Install third-party plugin**. 3. Enter the repository URL: ```text https://github.com/Big-Smarty/dsh-ultracode.git ``` A local clone path works too, and keeps the checkout linked for edits. 4. Install and enable the bundle, then **refresh the page once** so the client half loads. Or ask your DSH agent to install the bundle from the same URL. ### Local clone ```bash git clone https://github.com/Big-Smarty/dsh-ultracode.git cd dsh-ultracode npm test ``` Install the cloned directory through **Plugins → Add plugin** as above. The plugin is linked rather than copied, so later edits are picked up after a refresh. ## Usage | Action | How | | --- | --- | | Arm the session | `/ultracode`, or click the Ultracode pill in the composer | | Disarm | `/ultracode off`, the composer pill, or the panel overview's arm control | | Check the stance | `/ultracode status` | | Open the ledger | Click the `ULTRA` badge in the session header, or right sidebar → **Ultracode** | | Inspect a run | Expand **Finished**, open a phase, click an agent to read its child transcript | Ultracode is per session. Trivial requests — a lookup, a one-line edit, a single command — stay direct and say why. Substantive requests become workflows. The panel is workflow-focused. Shell and other background jobs remain in DSH's existing jobs control. ### Troubleshooting - **The `ULTRA` badge shows a red `!`** — hover it for the failure. The opener falls back to expanding the right sidebar guide. - **The Ultracode tab is missing or unavailable after an update** — hard-refresh the page (`Ctrl+Shift+R`). Client plugins are loaded from the page's module graph at boot, so a stale graph can survive a hot reload. - **The badge does nothing at all** — check **Settings → Plugins** for a page-local client sync error, then refresh and retry. ## How it works - `ultracode` projection — `{ active, pending }` folded from `command/run` / `command/done`. - `ultracodeRuns` projection — run, phase, member, status, and timing data folded from `tool-workflow/run-start|agent-start|agent-end|run-end`, with `turn/end` handling for interrupted and forked turns. - `ultracode:policy` — a prompt section at order `2650`, after the workflow tool's guidance at `2600`; empty while disarmed. - Client half — a composer pill, an `ULTRA` badge, an armed seam, and a right-sidebar tab type. Agent model/token/time values join each member's `childId` to the sessions catalog. More detail: [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md). ## Development ```bash npm test ``` The tests use Node's built-in test runner and cover the stance, the workflow ledger, abandoned-run closure, phase identity, cancellation, and checkpoint sanitization. CI runs on every push and pull request. ```text index.js Host half: projections, policy section, /ultracode command client.js Client half: switch, badge, seam, workflow sidebar, styles cordis.patch.yml Loads the bundle row locale/ Plugin-inventory metadata (en, zh) test/ Projection tests docs/ Architecture and design notes ``` ## Cost and safety Ultracode deliberately spends more tokens and time: it asks for several child agents per substantive task. `/ultracode off` returns to normal execution immediately. The plugin runs Host code in-process with your permissions. Install it only if you trust the source. It does not bypass approvals, sandbox policy, plan mode, or tool restrictions. ## License MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: Double-Enter send guard for DeepSeek Harness: the first Enter only arms the composer, the second one sends, any other key cancels. Stops half-written drafts from being sent by a stray Enter.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-enter-guard

Double-Enter send guard for **DeepSeek Harness**. The first `Enter` only *arms* the composer — nothing is sent. The second `Enter` sends. Pressing any other key cancels.

Stops a half-written message from being sent by an accidental Enter.

[中文说明 →](README.zh.md)

```
type message ──▶ Enter ──▶ ✗ not sent, composer outlined, "press Enter again to send"
                     │
                     ├── Enter (again) ──▶ ✓ sent
                     └── any other key ──▶ state cancelled, back to normal
```

## The gap it fills

DeepSeek Harness sends on `Enter` and has no confirmation step. Its only setting (`Settings → General → Enter behavior`) decides whether `Enter` **queues** or **steers** while the agent is busy — it does nothing about accidental sends when the agent is idle.

A community catalog scan (6084 DSH plugins) turns up nothing in this category. The closest neighbours only cover half the problem: `dsh-prompt-stash` stashes a draft on demand, `dsh-composer-plus` enhances the built-in queue, `dsh-sleep-send` adds scheduled sending, and the `prompt-refine` family rewrites the draft *before* sending — none of them intercept the Enter key.

## Behaviour

| Situation | Result |
|---|---|
| First `Enter` (no modifier, not IME-composing, not key-repeat) | **blocked** — composer outlined, hint shown |
| `Enter` while armed | passes through — DSH sends natively |
| **Any** other key while armed (letters, digits, Backspace, arrows, Shift, Ctrl, Alt, Win, CapsLock) | state cancelled immediately |
| Draft changed, IME composition start, blur, click outside | state cancelled |
| `Ctrl`/`Cmd`+`Enter`, clicking Send | **sends immediately**, no confirmation (deliberate escape hatch) |
| `/` command menu or `@` file menu open | passes through — Enter there selects a candidate |
| Holding `Enter` down (key repeat) | ignored, never sends by itself |
| Empty draft (no text, no attachment) | not intercepted |
| 2 seconds after arming | hint fades, **state is kept** — a later `Enter` still sends |

## Install

Not on npm yet — install from source:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Liyu147/dsh-enter-guard.git
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-enter-guard
```

Then **restart `dsh web`** (a page refresh is not enough — the client bundle is resolved at boot).

A local checkout works the same way; point `add` at the directory:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-enter-guard
```

Uninstall:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-enter-guard
```

Verify it is alive — open DevTools console and run:

```js
__dshEnterGuard.instance.inspect()
// => { version, mounted: true, armed: false, hasCard: true, everBlocked: false, ... }
```

`hasCard: false` means the composer anchor was not found — see *Compatibility*.
`everBlocked` flips to `true` once the guard has actually swallowed an Enter — that is the field proving the key path works end to end.

## Compatibility

Anchors come from the DSH web client (`dsh-client-ui-conversation`):

| Selector | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `[data-composer-card]` | composer card (outline + hint anchor) |
| `[data-composer-input]` | editable area (focus / emptiness check) |
| `[data-trigger-menu]` | command & file candidate menu (pass-through) |
| `[data-composer-chip]` | attachment / reference chips (counts as content) |

If a future DSH release renames these, the plugin **fails safe**: it becomes a no-op and native `Enter` behaviour is restored. It never swallows a message. A startup self-check warns in the console 5 s after boot when the anchor is missing.

Tested against DSH **0.1.5-rc.3** on Windows / Chrome.

## Known limitations

1. **Enter only.** The Send button and `Ctrl`/`Cmd`+`Enter` always send immediately — by design.
2. **Cannot stop plugins that call `submit()` directly.** Voice-input plugins that auto-send bypass the keyboard entirely.
3. **DOM-anchor dependent** (see above).
4. **Not verified on mobile virtual keyboards** — they may not emit `keydown`.
5. One composer card is assumed (the first match). Normal single-session UI is unaffected.

## Design note

The guard deliberately **does not clear the draft, does not call `setDraft`, does not touch the attachment pipeline**. The text simply stays in the composer and is sent later. That is why the whole feature fits in a read-only DOM listener and why it is safe to remove at any time.

## Testing

Two zero-dependency Node harnesses (fake DOM, no browser, no DSH involved):

```bash
node test_guard_enter_send_v1.js    # core state machine, 17 cases
node test_client_bundle_v1.js       # the packaged bundle, 12 cases
```

These live in the parent directory of this package (the development workspace), not in the published tarball.

Manual regression before trusting it — six checks:

1. `/` opens the command menu → `Enter` **selects** a candidate
2. `@` opens the file menu → `Enter` **inserts** the reference
3. `Shift`+`Enter` → inserts a **newline**, no outline
4. `Ctrl`+`Enter` → **sends immediately**
5. Agent busy + `Enter` → still queues / steers as configured
6. Paste an image, then `Enter` → attachment **is sent with the message**

## Security

Read-only DOM. A single document-level `keydown`/`input`/`compositionstart`/`focusout`/`click` listener set, one injected `<style>`, one floating hint `<div>`.

- no `fetch`, no `XMLHttpRequest`, no `WebSocket`
- no `localStorage`, no `sessionStorage`, no cookies
- no session data, no settings writes, no host-side code (the host half is an empty shell)
- all decision code is wrapped in `try/catch` and **fails open** — an internal error restores native behaviour instead of eating the key

## License

MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: QiuYa 增强工具箱：为 DeepSeek Harness 添加长文本附件、会话独立窗口、批量归档和计划批注。
plugins.readme_text:
# QiuYa 增强工具箱

给 DeepSeek Harness 加一点顺手的小功能。

## 安装

1. 打开 Harness 的 **插件 → 添加插件**。
2. 输入 npm 包名 **`dsh-qiuya-tools`**，点击安装。
3. 点击 **立即启用**，进入 **设置 → QiuYaTools**。

左下角账号菜单也有 QiuYaTools 入口。[查看 npm 包](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-qiuya-tools)。

也可在“添加插件”中粘贴 GitHub 安装包链接：

```text
https://github.com/z1223473749/dsh-QiuYaTools/releases/latest/download/dsh-qiuya-tools.tgz
```

镜像源同步新版本可能稍有延迟。暂时找不到包或新版本时，可稍后重试、切换到 [npm 官方源](https://registry.npmjs.org/)，或使用上面的 GitHub 链接。

## 功能

| 功能 | 怎么用 |
| --- | --- |
| 长文本附件 | 粘贴长文本自动转为 TXT，默认 1000 个字符或 15 行，阈值可调。 |
| 会话独立窗口 | 右键打开，或把会话拖出列表；再次打开同一会话会唤起已有窗口。 |
| 批量归档 | Shift 连选、⌘ / Ctrl 多选后右键归档，也可归档工作区全部会话。 |
| 计划批注 | 选中计划文字添加评论，提交修改建议，保留输入框原有草稿。 |
| 会话菜单 | 右键置顶、手动标记已读 / 未读、复制标题 / 会话 ID / 工作目录路径、打开目录；工作区也可移到顶部。 |
| 提示词建议 | 回复结束且输入框为空时，根据当前会话推荐下一句，失焦仍保留。聚焦后按 **Tab** 填入、**Esc** 隐藏，可修改后手动发送。 |
| Q主题「鲸与海」 | 手绘鲸鱼与白发少年背景，搭配柔和的半透明界面，支持浅色、深色外观。 |

六项增强默认开启，可单独开关，也可一键全选。Q主题默认关闭，独立设置。功能入口分为两排，无需横向滚动。

提示词建议使用当前会话所选模型，会产生少量额外模型用量。

## 界面预览

主题截图来自实际使用界面；设置页和提示词演示使用隔离示例。

**Q主题 · 新会话**

![Q主题鲸与海的新会话界面](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/z1223473749/dsh-QiuYaTools/main/docs/images/q-theme-home.png)

**Q主题 · 会话阅读**

![Q主题半透明会话与输入框](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/z1223473749/dsh-QiuYaTools/main/docs/images/q-theme-conversation.png)

**功能设置**

![QiuYaTools 双排功能入口与长文本转换阈值](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/z1223473749/dsh-QiuYaTools/main/docs/images/settings.jpg)

**Q主题设置**

![QiuYaTools 鲸与海主题设置与预览](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/z1223473749/dsh-QiuYaTools/main/docs/images/q-theme.jpg)

**提示词建议**

空输入框显示当前会话的建议，聚焦后按 Tab 填入。以下用示例回复演示交互，不调用真实模型。

![QiuYaTools 灰字提示词与 Tab 填入示例](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/z1223473749/dsh-QiuYaTools/main/docs/images/prompt-suggestions.jpg)

## 更新与兼容

在 **QiuYaTools → 版本更新 → 检查更新** 中升级，完成后完全退出并重新打开 Harness，原有设置保留。

当前适配官方 macOS Harness **0.2.1-rc.2**。独立窗口需要 **macOS 13+**，安装包包含 Apple Silicon 和 Intel 组件。

[npm 包](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-qiuya-tools) · [发布版本](https://github.com/z1223473749/dsh-QiuYaTools/releases) · [问题反馈](https://github.com/z1223473749/dsh-QiuYaTools/issues) · [使用与开发](https://github.com/z1223473749/dsh-QiuYaTools/blob/main/docs/development.md) · [www.qiuya.cc](https://www.qiuya.cc)

plugins.description: dsh session delete，提供会话「备份后删除」或「彻底删除」功能
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-session-archive-delete 给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的会话列表加一个安全的「删除」入口：**先完整备份到本地，校验通过后才删除**。 装上之后，在侧栏任意会话的「…」菜单最下方会多出删除选项： ## 为什么需要它 DSH 只有「归档」，没有删除。想真正释放磁盘空间就得手动去找 `~/.dsh/sessions/<工作区>//` 删目录，同时还要手动清理 `workspace.json` 和投影缓存——漏一步，侧栏就会留下点不开的空壳会话。 本插件把这件事做成一条安全的流水线： ``` 确认 → 复制会话目录 + 缓存 + 元数据快照 → 逐文件校验 → 删除原件 → 清理账本 ``` 任何一步失败都会中止，原会话保持完好。 ## 功能 | 功能 | 说明 | |---|---| | 备份删除 | 把会话完整备份到指定文件夹，校验通过后再删 | | 彻底删除 | 不备份，直接删除 | | 两种模式并存 | 菜单可同时显示两个选项，也可只显示其一 | | 子代理会话 | 自动找出该会话派生的所有子代理，一起备份、一起删除 | | 自定义备份位置 | 系统文件夹对话框选择，或直接输入路径 | | 四种命名方式 | 日期+主题 / ID前八位+主题 / 纯主题 / 前八位+主题+日期 | | 路径校验 | 无效路径当场提示，不会写入设置 | | 一键恢复 | 每个备份文件夹带 `RESTORE.txt`，按说明复制回去即可 | ## 安装 ### 方式一：在 DSH 界面里装（推荐） 左侧栏 **插件** → 右上角 **添加插件** → 输入包名安装： ``` @device1999/dsh-session-archive-delete ``` 装完重启 DSH。 ### 方式二：命令行 ```bash dsh plugin --profile add @device1999/dsh-session-archive-delete ``` `` 通常是 `desktop` 或 `web`，可在 `~/.dsh/profiles/` 下看到。 ### 方式三：从源码本地开发 ```bash git clone https://github.com/device1999/dsh-session-archive-delete.git dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:/path/to/dsh-session-archive-delete ``` 或在 profile 的 `package.json` 里写 `link:` 依赖，然后在 `node_modules` 里建一个 指向源码目录的 junction（Windows）或 symlink（macOS / Linux）。 ## 使用 ### 删除一个会话 1. 侧栏会话行点「…」 2. 选「备份删除」或「彻底删除」 3. 确认框里核对会话名、ID 和备份路径 4. 点「确认」 删除成功后侧栏会立即刷新；如果删的是当前会话，会自动跳到下一个。 ### 设置 **设置 → 备份删除**： | 设置项 | 选项 | |---|---| | 删除模式 | 两个菜单项同时显示 / 只显示「备份删除」/ 只显示「彻底删除」 | | 备份位置 | 点击选择文件夹，或直接编辑地址栏；留空 = 默认位置 | | 备份文件夹命名 | 四种格式任选 | 设置保存在 `~/.dsh/dsh-session-archive-delete.json`。 ### 默认备份位置 按以下优先级确定： 1. 设置里填写的路径 2. 环境变量 `DSH_ARCHIVE_ROOT` 3. 插件配置 `workspaceRoot` 4. 自动推断：从会话记录里选出使用最多的工作区目录 5. 都拿不到时：`<用户主目录>/DSH-归档会话` > 备份位置不能设在 `~/.dsh` 内部，否则 DSH 会把它当成数据目录重新扫描。 ## 备份结构 ``` <备份位置>/<按命名规则生成的文件夹>/ sessions/<工作区目录>/<会话id>/ 会话原始文件（保留原名） projcache/<会话id>.json 界面投影缓存 meta/workspace.json 删除前的元数据快照 meta/session_projcache.json manifest.json 清单：完整 id、标题、大小、子代理列表 RESTORE.txt 恢复步骤 ``` 子代理会话也备份在同一个文件夹的 `sessions/` 下，清单里列在 `subagents` 字段。 ## 恢复一个会话 详见每个备份文件夹里的 `RESTORE.txt`，大意是： 1. 完全退出 DSH 2. 把 `sessions/<工作区>/<会话id>` 复制回 `~/.dsh/sessions/<工作区>/` 3. 把 `projcache/<会话id>.json` 复制回 `~/.dsh/storages/session_projcache/sessions/` 4. 在 `~/.dsh/storages/workspace.json` 里把会话 id 加回对应工作区的 `sessionIds` 5. 启动 DSH ## 安全性 - **不删未校验的内容**：复制后逐文件比对大小与数量，不一致就中止 - **删前先摘账本**：先把引用从 `workspace.json` 移除并落盘，再删文件， 避免 DSH 内存状态把引用写回 - **删后复查**：目录删除后检查 3 次，防止文件句柄重建目录 - **路径边界校验**：会话目录必须位于 `~/.dsh/sessions` 下，且目录名与会话 id 完全一致 - **运行中会话**：先取消当前轮次再删除，不会留下半截日志 ## 系统要求 - DSH 0.2.x（Web / 桌面客户端） - Windows / macOS / Linux - 系统文件夹对话框依赖 PowerShell 7（Windows）。没有 pwsh 时会自动回退到页面内目录浏览 ## 已知限制 - 默认备份位置依赖宿主提供的 `sessionQuery` 服务来推断工作区；取不到时回退到用户主目录 - 子代理关系来自会话 header 的 `parentSession` 字段，会话文件是 zstd 压缩，无法纯读盘解析 - 备份是完整复制，大会话会占用相应磁盘空间 ## 卸载 ```bash dsh plugin --profile remove dsh-session-archive-delete ``` 重启 DSH。已生成的备份文件夹不会被删除，可按需自行清理。 ## License MIT

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 本地文件中心：按对话归档生成文件，支持跨对话搜索、稳定回指和继续加工。
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH File Hub

[![CI](https://github.com/311miaowa/DSH-File-Hub/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/311miaowa/DSH-File-Hub/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

> 给 DeepSeek Harness 的本地文件中心：把生成的文件按对话归档，支持跨对话关键词检索，并为每个文件保留可回到来源事件的文件回指。

> **隐私提示**：索引在本机 Host 内存中建立；全局搜索会跨 Session 展示文件元信息、片段和历史请求。不要把不可信的工作区、日志或文件内容交给不受信任的模型。详见 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。

`dsh-file-hub` 是一个纯 JavaScript 的 DeepSeek Harness 插件，不需要构建步骤。它在 Web 侧栏增加「文件中心」，同时向 Agent 暴露只读工具 `file_hub`。

---

## 为什么需要它

DeepSeek Harness 的生成文件通常散落在不同会话、不同工作区里。文件本身还在磁盘上，但当你想找“上次那个季度报告”或“二开-M3 里生成的 SQL”时，通常只能靠记忆翻会话。

这个插件补的是这层缺失的索引：

- 文件属于哪个对话；
- 由哪一次工具调用产生；
- 对应哪一轮、哪一步、哪个事件；
- 当时的请求和工具结果是什么；
- 文件现在是否还在原路径。

## 功能

- **按对话归档**
  - 索引成功执行的 `write`、`edit`、`present`、`str_replace_editor` 调用。
  - 同一文件的多次修改会折叠为一个文件记录，并保留多次出处。
  - 单个对话超过 10 个文件时，列表按 10 条一页返回，UI 底部显示页码索引。
- **全局关键词搜索**
  - 匹配文件名、相对路径、对话标题、交付描述，以及写入/编辑内容。
  - 空格分隔多个关键词，所有关键词必须命中。
  - 支持按对话过滤。
  - 返回准确命中总数，并用 `offset` / `nextOffset` 分页；UI 底部提供页码索引。
- **精确回指**
  - 每条记录保留会话 ID、事件序号、Turn/Step、工具名、调用 ID。
  - Agent 可读取回指事件前后的请求、工具调用、工具结果和当前文件状态。
  - 打开文件时与最近一次 `write` 基线比较：小文件做完整内容哈希，大文件只比大小；无法判断时明确返回 `unknown`，不假装“未变化”。
- **继续加工**
  - UI 提供「复制继续加工指令」和「复制回指 ID」。
  - 将指令粘贴到任意对话，Agent 会用 `file_hub` 打开回指，再读取文件继续工作。
- **打开所在文件夹**
  - 详情里的用户显式动作：只提交回指 ID，Host 重新校验工作区与符号链接后，用无 shell 的 argv 打开文件所在目录。
  - 使用可见、detached 的启动器，并等待启动器的早期失败；不会在 `spawn()` 返回时立即声称成功。
  - Windows 使用 `explorer.exe` 加编码后的文件夹 file URI，macOS 使用 `open <folder>`，Linux 使用 `xdg-open <folder>`。
  - 不使用 `ctx.subprocess`：它在 Windows 会隐藏 GUI 窗口，这正是早期实现只弹提示、不显示文件夹的原因。
  - 不做纯浏览器拖拽；原因见「覆盖范围与限制」。
- **文件只读、显式动作除外**
  - 插件不写入、移动、删除、上传文件，也不执行 shell。
  - 浏览器查询路由只有 `GET`；唯一 `POST` 是经过鉴权、Origin 检查和回指校验的「打开所在文件夹」。
  - 不创建新的 Session 事件类型，不落盘新索引。
- **启动预热**
  - 插件随 profile 加载后，默认等待约 2 秒在后台建立索引，不阻塞 Harness 启动。
  - 这只是插件索引预热，不创建 Windows 启动项，也不会让 DSH 随系统开机启动。

## 界面

文件中心采用克制的深色布局：左侧按对话归档，中间是当前对话的文件列表和底部页码，右侧是文件详情。来源上下文、当前文件预览和历史出处默认折叠；文件列表与全局搜索结果都使用页码索引，不做无限追加。

![文件中心界面：左侧对话归档，中间文件列表与页码，右侧文件详情](docs/images/file-hub-detail.png)

> 截图使用深色主题和匿名示例数据。

## 安装

### 环境

- 支持 Web UI 和插件管理器的 DeepSeek Harness profile。
- 当前版本在 **DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 的 Web profile** 上验证。
- 不需要 Node 构建、不需要安装脚本、没有第三方运行时依赖。

### 从本地目录安装

```text
git clone https://github.com/311miaowa/DSH-File-Hub.git
```

然后在 Harness 中让 Agent 使用插件管理器安装该目录：

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle target=/absolute/path/to/dsh-file-hub
```

Windows 下把路径写成绝对路径，例如：

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle target=D:\path\to\dsh-file-hub
```

插件管理器会把它加入当前 profile，并选择 bundle。安装后：

- 侧栏出现「文件中心」；
- Agent 工具列表出现 `file_hub`。

### 从 Git 地址安装

如果你的 Harness 版本支持从 Git 安装，也可以：

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle target=https://github.com/311miaowa/DSH-File-Hub
```

### 刷新页面

`client.js` 是已加载的浏览器 bundle。没有运行 `pnpm run dev:web` 时，浏览器不会自动替换它：

```text
Ctrl+F5
```

如果侧栏没有「文件中心」，先强制刷新一次页面。

## 使用

1. 点击侧栏「文件中心」。
2. 左侧选择对话，或在顶部输入关键词进行全局搜索。
3. 点击文件行，右侧会显示回指详情。
4. 用「复制继续加工指令」把回指交给 Agent，或复制回指 ID 手动引用。

### 给 Agent 的示例

```text
用 file_hub 搜索“季度 报告”，然后打开最相关的那条回指。
```

```text
用 file_hub 打开 fh_0123456789abcdef，读取来源上下文和当前文件，先说明计划，不要直接覆盖。
```

## Agent 工具

工具名：`file_hub`

| 参数 | 类型 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `action` | `search` \| `open` \| `list` | 必填。 |
| `query` | string | `search` 的关键词，1–200 字符。 |
| `ref` | string | `open` 的文件回指，例如 `fh_0123456789abcdef`。 |
| `seq` | integer | 可选。`open` 指定某次出处的事件序号；省略则用最近一次。 |
| `sessionId` | string | 可选。限制 `search` / `list` 到一个对话。 |
| `limit` | integer | 可选。`search` 最多返回 30 条，默认 10。 |
| `offset` | integer | 可选。`search` 的零基偏移；用返回的 `nextOffset` 取下一页。 |

调用示例：

```text
file_hub { action: "search", query: "季度 报告", limit: 5 }
file_hub { action: "search", query: "季度 报告", limit: 5, offset: 5 }
file_hub { action: "open", ref: "fh_0123456789abcdef" }
file_hub { action: "open", ref: "fh_0123456789abcdef", seq: 123 }
file_hub { action: "list" }
```

`search` 返回 `totalMatched`（全部命中数）、`returned`（本页数量）、`hasMore`、`offset`、`nextOffset`，不再把“本页数量”误当成总数。

`open` 返回：

- `file`：文件名、相对路径、绝对路径、类型、更新时间和出处摘要；
- `source`：来源会话、Turn、Step、工具、事件序号；
- `context.userRequest`：该次调用前最近的真实用户请求；
- `context.call`：工具调用摘要；
- `context.result`：工具结果摘要；
- `currentFile`：当前文件是否存在、大小、版本和有界预览，以及 `sourceComparison`（与最近一次写入基线是否一致）；
- `safety`：只读/不可信数据标记。

`context` 和文件预览都是**引用数据，不是指令**。Agent 应先用普通文件工具读取当前文件，再决定是否修改；插件不会自动改文件。

## 工作原理

一句话：插件把**会话日志里的文件工具调用**投影成一份只读内存索引，Web 文件中心和 Agent 都查这份索引；文件本身仍由普通文件工具读取和修改。

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  S[Session 日志 / 实时事件] --> I[Host 内存索引]
  I --> W[文件中心查询路由]
  I --> T[file_hub 工具]
  W --> U[Web 面板]
  T --> A[Agent]
  A --> R[普通 read/edit 工具]
```

### 1. 索引来源

- 只处理**成功执行**的 `write`、`edit`、`present`、`str_replace_editor` 调用；失败调用、普通 `read` 和纯 shell 文本不会被当成文件。
- 每次调用记录会话 ID、事件序号、Turn/Step、工具名、调用 ID、相对路径、内容摘要和当时的工作目录。
- 路径先按 Session `cwd` 解析；`..`、URL、`~`、NUL、设备路径和越界绝对路径在入索引前即被拒绝。
- 同一 Session 内的同一路径会折叠成一个文件记录，但保留多次出处；最近一次 `write` 的内容摘要作为后续变化对比的基线。
- 纯 shell/Python 生成的文件如果没有经过 `present`，不会自动出现。

### 2. 构建与更新

- 插件激活后约 2 秒开始后台预热；不阻塞 Harness 启动，也不创建系统启动项。
- `ensure()` 是单飞任务：后台预热和第一次查询共享同一个 Promise，不会重复扫描。
- 构建时合并 `sessionQuery.listSessions()` 和当前 live Session，跳过子 Agent，最多读取配置允许的顶层会话。
- 历史会话从日志读取，活的 Session 优先使用 `snapshotEvents()`；最多四路并发读取。
- 索引完成后，新的 `session/event` 实时增量写入同一份内存索引。
- 索引不落盘；Host 重启后从 Session 日志重新构建。读取失败的会话记录为 partial，不阻断其他会话。

### 3. 查询与回指

- 文件中心查询走受 Harness Connection 鉴权的 exact 路由；搜索支持多关键词、标题/路径/正文匹配、准确总数和 offset 分页。
- 每个文件暴露一个不透明回指 `fh_` + 16 位十六进制；调用方不能提交任意绝对路径。
- `open` 回指时，Host 按引用反查记录，读取调用前后的事件窗口（前 50、后 4），返回用户请求、工具调用、工具结果、文件当前状态和有界预览。
- 当前文件与最近一次 `write` 基线比较：
  - 不超过 8 MB 的文本做完整内容哈希，并统一 CRLF/LF；
  - 二进制文件按字节哈希；
  - 超过 8 MB 时无法做完整内容对比，只能报告大小并返回 `unknown`；
  - 无基线、文件被删、读取失败或超过阈值时返回 `unknown`，不假装“未变化”。

### 4. 两个调用方

- **Web 文件中心**：读取同一份 Host 索引，展示对话/文件/详情，支持复制回指、复制继续加工指令和分页浏览。
- **Agent 工具**：`file_hub` 提供 `search`、`open`、`list`，返回值与 UI 同源，且统一标记为引用数据，避免把文件内容当成指令。
- **唯一文件系统动作**：用户在详情里显式点击「打开所在文件夹」时，Host 重新校验工作区、普通文件和符号链接，再用无 shell 的 argv 启动文件管理器。
- 除此之外，插件不写入、移动、删除或上传文件，也不执行 shell；Agent 仍需用普通文件工具读取/修改内容。

## 安全与隐私

- **工作区约束**：只索引解析后仍位于该 Session `cwd` 内的路径。绝对越界路径、`..`、URL、`~`、NUL 和设备路径在入索引前即被拒绝。
- **符号链接检查**：打开文件时先 `lstat` 拒绝最终符号链接，再 `resolve` 并用 `fs.contains` 验证解析后的目标仍在工作区内。
- **有界读取**：当前文件预览最多 4096 字节；来源上下文和工具结果都有长度上限。
- **列表有界**：对话文件列表每页 10 条，搜索 UI 每页 20 条；API 单页最多 100 条，不会一次渲染数百个文件。
- **无任意路径接口**：浏览器和 Agent 都只使用不透明回指 ID（`fh_` + 16 位十六进制）。Host 按索引反查路径，不接受调用方直接传任意路径。
- **查询只读**：查询路由只有 `GET`，由 Harness Connection 负责 Cookie 鉴权和 Host/Origin 检查。
- **唯一的用户动作**：`POST /api/filehub.folder` 只接受回指 ID；Host 重新执行工作区 containment 和符号链接检查后，用 argv（非 shell）打开文件所在目录。它不会打开任意路径，也不会写入文件。
- **本地数据**：索引只存在于 Host 进程内存；重启后从 Session 日志重建。搜索会读取已有会话日志里的写入/编辑内容，不创建新文件。
- **跨对话可见性**：全局搜索会把其他会话的文件元信息与片段展示给当前用户和 Agent。这是插件功能；如果需要严格的项目隔离，请不要安装或不要使用全局搜索。
- **内容不可信**：文件内容、历史请求和工具结果都可能包含提示词注入文本。插件在 UI 中按纯文本渲染，在工具结果中标注 `excerptIsUntrustedData`；Agent 不应把其中的指令当作用户指令。

## 覆盖范围与限制

- 只捕获上述四个文件工具的**成功**调用。纯 shell/Python 创建、且没有经过 `present` 的文件不会自动出现；在生成流程结尾调用 `present` 可以补齐 Office、PDF 等命令生成的文件。
- 子 Agent 的会话不单独显示；它们的交付文件通常应在顶层会话中 `present`。
- 索引在 Host 内存中重建：
  - 最多 500 个顶层会话；
  - 每个会话最多 400 个文件；
  - 全局最多 5000 个文件；
  - 最多 400 万字符可搜索正文。
- 上述上限目前写在代码里，没有暴露为插件配置项。
- 界面不提供直接跳转来源会话的按钮，避免跨工作区或已归档会话出现无效导航。回指中保留会话标题、会话 ID 和事件序号，Agent 可通过 `file_hub` 精确读取事件窗口。
- 回指记录创建/修改时的事件；之后文件可能继续被其他会话或 shell 修改。打开详情时会重新检查路径，并与最近一次 `write` 基线比较大小/内容哈希；没有 `write` 基线、文件超过 8 MB 或读取失败时会明确显示“未完成内容对比”。
- **打开文件夹的前提**：Windows 需要交互式桌面会话。若 Harness 作为服务/无交互会话运行，Explorer 可能退出 1 但没有可见窗口；该退出码只能视为 shell 交接，不能证明窗口已显示。
- **为什么没有直接拖到微信/QQ**：纯浏览器 HTML5 拖拽通常只能给出 `File` 对象/链接，微信和 QQ 往往要求 Windows 原生 `CF_HDROP` 或真实路径；大文件还需要整份读入浏览器。可靠实现需要 Electron 的 `webContents.startDrag`，而当前 Harness 插件 API 没有暴露这层桌面桥。因此先提供稳定的「打开所在文件夹」，由用户从资源管理器拖入微信/QQ。
- 仅支持 Web 侧栏；不提供 TUI/CLI 界面。
- 当前 UI 文案支持中文和英文，浏览器刷新后生效。

## 项目结构

```text
.
├── client.js            # Web 文件中心与 slot 注册
├── core.js              # 纯函数：路径约束、工具解析、记录折叠、搜索
├── index.js             # Host 索引、查询/打开文件夹路由、file_hub 工具
├── cordis.patch.yml     # bundle patch
├── package.json         # Harness bundle/client 声明
├── locale/
│   ├── zh.json          # 插件管理器的中文元数据
│   └── en.json          # 插件管理器的英文元数据
├── icon.svg             # 插件图标
├── LICENSE              # MIT
├── SECURITY.md          # 安全模型和漏洞报告方式

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-scnet-plan

[![CI](https://github.com/Ronnie-Young/dsh-scnet-plan/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Ronnie-Young/dsh-scnet-plan/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

**在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接看 SCNet Token Plan 还剩多少，不用再开控制台。**

SCNet（超算互联网）的 Token Plan 按月发 Credits，但余额只有登录控制台才看得到。装上这个插件后：

- 侧栏多一个面板：**剩余比例圆环、今日/日均消耗、每日热力图、token 构成**，一眼看完；
- 输入框下方有个小徽标：剩余百分比 + 本话题累计 Credits；每条消息末尾显示本轮 Credits（都只在当前模型属于 SCNet 时出现，按 token 与 SCNet 模型单价估算）；
- 直接问模型「我还剩多少额度」，它会用 `get_scnet_plan` 自己查。

![面板界面：左侧浅色，右侧深色](docs/panel-themes.png)

*左：浅色　右：深色（同一界面，只是主题不同）*

## 安装

需要先装好 DeepSeek Harness（桌面版或 CLI）。在 DSH 对话里让 agent 调 `plugin_manager install_bundle`，`target` 按下面的方式填：

| 方式 | target | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **插件市场**（发现页） | 先在「发现 → 管理索引源」添加 `https://ronnie-young.github.io/dsh-plugins-market/index.json`，再在市场里点安装 | 最接近“应用商店”的体验 |
| **GitHub 源**（免 clone） | `github:Ronnie-Young/dsh-scnet-plan#v0.0.3` | pnpm 直接拉取，不用本地目录 |
| **Release 压缩包** | `https://github.com/Ronnie-Young/dsh-scnet-plan/releases/download/v0.0.3/dsh-scnet-plan-0.0.3.tgz` | 从 GitHub Release 直链安装 |
| 本地目录（开发/排错） | `/你的路径/dsh-scnet-plan` | 需要先 `git clone` |
| npm（首次发布后启用） | `dsh-scnet-plan` | 发布后一行安装 |

> 安装会申请 danger-full-access 权限，按提示批准。装完**刷新页面**，侧栏出现「SCNet 套餐」图标就成功了。

如果还想更省事，也可以让 agent 直接读这个仓库的 README，把上面的 target 告诉它。

## 插件市场

本插件收录在个人维护的市场仓库 [dsh-plugins-market](https://github.com/Ronnie-Young/dsh-plugins-market) 里。添加一次索引源后，就能在 DSH 的「发现」页安装和更新：

```text
https://ronnie-young.github.io/dsh-plugins-market/index.json
```

打开 **插件 → 发现 → 管理索引源 → 添加索引源**，粘贴上面的地址即可（索引源只能由用户手动添加）。

## 第一次使用：登录一次

打开 **设置 → SCNet 套餐**，两种方式任选：

1. **短信验证码**：填手机号 → 获取验证码 → 输入 6 位码 → 登录；
2. **账号密码**：填账号密码，需要图形验证码时按提示输入。

登录成功后插件会先用这个会话真读一次订阅，确认能读到额度才保存。

> **隐私**：手机号、验证码、密码只用于这一次登录请求——不保存、不写日志、不显示、不进模型上下文。之后自动刷新只用会话 Cookie。

## 面板上都是什么

| 区域 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 圆环 | 剩余百分比，>20% 绿、6.7–20% 琥珀、<6.7% 红 |
| 右侧 | 剩余天数、今日消耗、日均消耗、可用模型数 |
| 中间 | 剩余 Credits + 已用/总额度 |
| token 行 | 输入 / 缓存命中 / 输出（缓存命中是 SCNet 单独计量的，不是输入的子集） |
| 热力图 | 订阅周期内每天的 Credits 消耗，蓝色 4 档 |
| 底部 | 明细账单入口；「套餐与模型」可展开看档位和模型清单 |

每日用量读取失败不影响额度数字，面板会提示。

## 可选配置

一般不用改。想调刷新频率、预警线、关闭工具时，在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖：

```yaml
- id: scnet-plan
  config:
    refreshIntervalSec: 60    # 秒；0 = 只手动刷新
    warnBelowPercent: 20      # 低于此比例转琥珀色
    tool: true                # 是否注册 get_scnet_plan
    accountLogin: true        # 是否允许设置页登录
```

<details>
<summary>完整配置项</summary>

| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `SCNET_API_KEY` | API Key 的凭据引用名（只用于列模型） |
| `baseUrl` | `https://api.scnet.cn` | OpenAI 兼容网关 |
| `consoleBaseUrl` | `https://www.scnet.cn` | 控制台地址 |
| `apiBasePath` | `/api/llm/v1` | 网关路径前缀 |
| `consoleCookieEnv` | `SCNET_CONSOLE_COOKIE` | 会话 Cookie 的凭据引用名 |
| `refreshIntervalSec` | `60` | 缓存与自动刷新间隔 |
| `creditInputPer1K` | `2` | 输入 token 每千个折算的 Credits 估算值（取不到模型单价时使用） |
| `creditCachedPer1K` | `0.2` | 缓存命中 token 每千个的 Credits 估算值 |
| `creditOutputPer1K` | `8` | 输出 token 每千个的 Credits 估算值 |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `15000` | 单次请求超时 |
| `includeModels` | `true` | 是否附带模型列表与套餐目录 |
| `warnBelowPercent` | `20` | 预警线 |
| `routePath` | `/scnet-plan/snapshot` | Host 快照路由 |
| `tool` | `true` | 注册 `get_scnet_plan` |
| `manageCookie` | `true` | 允许手动粘贴 Cookie（高级退路） |
| `accountLogin` | `true` | 允许短信/密码登录 |
| `loginTimeoutSec` | `30` | 登录请求超时 |

</details>

## 常见问题

**面板显示「待连接」？**
还没登录。去 设置 → SCNet 套餐 登录一次。

**数字一直不变？**
默认 1 分钟刷新一次；点面板右上角「刷新」可立即拉取。SCNet 自己的统计有约 5 分钟延迟，面板数字可能滞后于实时用量。

**过几天又提示登录失效？**
会话 Cookie 会过期，重新登录一次即可。密码和验证码从不保存。

**能用 API Key 代替登录吗？**
不能。`sk-tp-…` 只能列模型，额度接口只认控制台会话——这也是为什么要登录一次。

**不想用了？**
`plugin_manager remove_bundle target = dsh-scnet-plan`。

## 更新

```bash
git pull
```

然后在 DSH 里重新安装（`remove_bundle` 再 `install_bundle`），刷新页面。发版与发布流程见 [docs/publishing.md](docs/publishing.md)。

## 开发

```bash
npm test                      # 36 个单测
node scripts/probe.mjs --self-test
```

`client.js` 是手写的浏览器 bundle，不需要打包器；改完刷新页面即可。

项目结构与接口细节见 [docs/scnet-api.md](docs/scnet-api.md) 和 [docs/plugin-platform.md](docs/plugin-platform.md)。

## License

MIT © Ronnie-Young

plugins.description: 把钉钉 Teambition 接进 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏：在 DSH 内浏览项目 / 任务列表 / 卡片，新建与移动卡片，并把任意卡片放到指定的 DSH 工作区里执行。Teambition panel for the DSH Web GUI.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-teambition

English | [中文说明](README.zh.md)

**Bring Teambition into the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.** Browse projects, task
lists and cards inside DSH, operate them without leaving the GUI, and run any
card in a DSH workspace you pick: the plugin creates a session in that workspace
and submits the card's title, project, link, updated time and note as the opening
prompt.

- Repository: <https://github.com/Yeezone/dsh-teambition>
- Latest release: `v0.1` (`0.1.0`); `main` is at `0.5.0`
- License: Apache-2.0

## Why it exists

Work happens in DSH, while tasks and bugs live in Teambition. Switching windows
to read a card, then pasting its context into a session, is the part worth
automating. The plugin turns Teambition into a DSH panel:

1. Click **Teambition** in the sidebar; the panel opens in the main column.
2. Pick a project (and a task list, for projects with several), then read cards
   per kanban column.
3. Click **Run** on a card: the plugin creates a session in the bound workspace,
   submits the card title, project, link, updated time and note as one queued
   prompt, then opens that session.

Where a card runs is configurable: a per-card binding wins, then the project
default, then the panel-wide default workspace.

## Where it lives in the GUI

- **Sidebar row**: registered on the official `sidebar.panellist` seat, after
  "Plugins" and "Automations".
- **Main page**: registered on the official `main` seat, with a Tasks / Board
  switcher plus project / task list selectors, refresh and settings.
- **Task list (default unless the default view is the board)**: a table close to
  the Teambition task module —
  task number, title, assignee avatar and name, due date (red when overdue), stage
  and last update. The toolbar searches, groups by task list / stage / assignee,
  filters by open / done / overdue / unassigned state, and sorts by updated,
  created, due or priority. Clicking a row slides a detail drawer in from the
  right (number, priority, assignee, due, stage, task list, created / updated,
  note body) which can also run the card, complete it and rebind its workspace.
- **Board**: the project views of the Teambition web board (for example "All
  tasks", a workflow-status view, "My tasks", "Created by me") in a rail on the
  left. A view saved with a workflow vertical renders one column per workflow
  status; stage views render one column group per stage. Every column header has
  a "+" that opens the create form with that column preselected, and cards carry
  their workspace marker plus the actions Run, Complete (advance the workflow
  status), Open in Teambition and Bind workspace. Completed cards show a green
  check before a struck-through title. Cards drag between columns: drop one on
  another column to move it there (workflow status or stage, by the column kind).
- **New card form** at the bottom of the panel: title, optional note, target
  stage.
- **Settings view**: cookie (write / clear), diagnose probes, operator id,
  endpoint base, default view (task list / board), default workspace, and a
  per-project workspace table.

## Features

- Task module: a task table (number, title, assignee, due, stage, update time)
  with search / grouping / filtering / sorting and a slide-over detail drawer; the
  chosen view and toolbar settings persist in `localStorage`.
- Task-list filter: when a project has several lists, the toolbar narrows the
  table to one of them; switching project clears it back to every list.
- Default view: the settings view picks task list or board, and the panel plus
  every project switch open on it.
- Saved views and workflow boards: the board rail lists the project views saved
  in Teambition and remembers the selection per project. Workflow views render
  one column per workflow status (the tasks module look), stage views keep the
  stage columns; "executed by me" / "created by me" views filter their cards,
  and every column can quick-add a card.
- Drag and drop: grab a card on the board and drop it on another column to move
  it there. Workflow status columns update the status, stage columns update the
  stage, the hovered column highlights, and busy cards stay non-draggable.
- Two-level switching (project, then task list). Projects with many task lists
  are grouped by list instead of flattened into dozens of same-named columns; the
  selection is remembered in `localStorage` and restored on the next visit.
- The board view stays available through the Board tab, with the same card
  creation and stage moving as before.
- Card actions: run in DSH, complete the card or advance it to the next open
  workflow status, open in Teambition, bind an execution workspace. Completed
  cards are checked (green check, struck-through title on the board, a "done"
  badge in the task list, a state row in the drawer).
- Workspace bindings with card > project > panel-default precedence, resolved by
  the host so the browser half never needs the full binding table.
- Diagnostics: six candidate endpoints are probed one by one and the HTTP status
  plus verdict of each attempt is shown, which makes an expired cookie or an API
  change easy to spot.
- One model-visible agent tool, `teambition`: list projects, read a project,
  create cards, move cards, record workspace bindings.
- Bilingual UI (zh / en) that follows the DSH language and light / dark theme.

## Quick start

1. Sign in to <https://www.teambition.com> in a browser, open DevTools → Network,
   refresh, select any request, and copy its whole **Cookie request header** (not
   the page URL).
2. In DSH: sidebar → **Teambition** → **Settings** → paste the cookie → save →
   **Diagnose**. A usable cookie reports `Cookie accepted`.
3. Back on the board, choose a project (and a task list if the project has
   several; "all task lists" is grouped by list).
4. Choose a default workspace in settings, or bind one per project or per card.
5. Click **Run** on a card; a session opens in that workspace with the card
   context already submitted.

> Cookies expire. When they do, the board and the diagnose verdict report
> `HTTP 401 AccessTokenMissing`; copy a fresh cookie and save it again.

## Install

`@yeezone/dsh-client-ui-teambition` is a dual-face cordis plugin package: the
node half (`exports "."`) runs in the host process and serves
`POST /teambition/*`; the browser half (`exports "./client"`) is served to the
GUI as `/plugins/@yeezone/dsh-client-ui-teambition/client.js`.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Yeezone/dsh-teambition.git
cd dsh-teambition
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm run build
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add link:$PWD
```

The bundle patch (`cordis.patch.yml`) inserts the `ui-teambition` row, so the
profile boot mounts both halves. A **full application restart** is required: the
browser half only loads when the composition includes the new row. After that,
client-only changes need a page refresh.

If the profile is app-owned (the packaged desktop app's `desktop` profile), the
CLI refuses to write it: install from the GUI Plugins page, or add the dependency
and the `dsh.profile.bundles` row to the profile's `package.json` manually, then
restart.

## Data and privacy

- Host state lives in `$DSH_HOME/teambition/config.json` (mode `0600`): cookie,
  operator id, endpoint base, workspace bindings, the last diagnose pass, and the
  last project list. Writes are atomic (temp file + rename).
- The browser half receives `configured` and a four character `cookieTail` only;
  the cookie never crosses the host / browser boundary and never reaches
  model-visible output.
- Remote reads use Teambition's own web REST API through a candidate list plus a
  `diagnose` probe rather than hardcoded assumptions; response previews are
  redacted before they reach the settings view.
- The plugin writes to Teambition only for explicit actions (create card, change
  stage, change status); running a card only creates a local DSH session.

## Known limits

- Teambition's web REST API is an internal, cookie-authenticated API (not the
  official open API) and may change without notice.
- Pushing a workflow status depends on the project exposing that endpoint;

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-teams-optimizer

An independent DeepSeek Harness plugin to configure the **actual Agent Teams teammate admission limit**. It changes the number checked when `spawn_teammate` creates a new, durable teammate; it does not merely ask the model to use more teammates.

In the official Agent Teams profile, `agent-team` is configured with `maxMembers: 8`. The underlying `TeamService` default is 16 when no profile override is provided. This plugin defaults to **16** and allows any positive safe integer.

## Install

First enable the official **Agent Teams** bundle. Then install the optimizer in the same profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:Soulize/dsh-agent-teams-optimizer#main"
```

Restart DSH after adding the plugin. In Web/Desktop, open **Plugins -> dsh-agent-teams-optimizer -> agent-teams-optimizer -> Configure**, enter the desired **maxMembers**, and save. DSH stores the option in the current profile; changes are applied to the active Team service without needing to restart, provided the current official internal layout is compatible.

For direct profile configuration, set:

```yaml
- id: agent-teams-optimizer
  config:
    maxMembers: 32
```

The plugin's own bundle patch only inserts `agent-teams-optimizer`. It intentionally does **not** overwrite the official Agent Teams config row or any unrelated settings.

## Behavior

- The limit counts **teammates** only; the Lead is not counted.
- It is a cumulative, immutable roster limit, **not** a simultaneous-running limit. Even an inactive or failed member keeps its slot; increasing the limit permits more distinct names. Lowering the limit does not delete historical members.
- It changes the real TeamRoster admission field, so existing and future teams in the current Team service honor the new value.
- Regular Subagent, workflow and nested delegation limits are not changed.
- If Agent Teams is disabled, the optimizer remains idle. It binds automatically when the official `agentTeams` service becomes available.
- Disabling/unmounting this plugin restores the original roster limit **only if no other component has changed the same field**.

## Implementation and compatibility

The official `TeamService` currently captures `maxMembers` in its `TeamRoster` constructor and offers no public runtime setter. Modifying the `agent-team` Cordis profile row is the **supported** method for setting the limit at service startup. This plugin instead provides an editable, live UI by conditionally updating the existing roster's `maxMembers` property. This is **an undocumented internal field**, not a stable DSH API.

The adapter checks that the official service and writable field have the expected shapes before changing anything. If a future DSH release changes those internals, the plugin logs a warning and does not pretend the setting took effect. It does not replace `spawnTeammate`, monkey-patch tool handlers, or mutate the roster's historical records.

For a stable configuration-only alternative, use this profile override (the whole `config` object is replaced by a patch, so include the other fields to retain the official explicit values):

```yaml
- id: agent-team
  config:
    maxMembers: 32
    maxTasks: 256
    maxMessageBytes: 65536
    disposalTimeoutMs: 5000
```

These two approaches should not be used to compete for the same limit at runtime. If both are present, the optimizer treats the effective value seen on service mounting as its restoration baseline.

## Verify

When a compatible Team service mounts, check the DSH Host log for a line such as:

```text
agent-teams-optimizer: maxMembers=32 (previous=8, official baseline=8, reason=service-mounted)
```

Test by creating more than eight distinct teammates in one Team. A ninth successful creation confirms that the **runtime** limit, not merely the prompt, has changed. Actual model behavior is a separate matter: raising the cap does not force the Lead to spawn more agents.

Run the unit tests with `npm test` (uses Node's built-in test runner).

## Requirements

- Official DeepSeek Harness Agent Teams service (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team`), not a third-party Teams implementation.
- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.0-rc.1`; no maximum DSH version is imposed. Compatibility is verified by the runtime adapter on each mount.
- Node.js `>=22.19.0` for DSH.

License: MIT.

plugins.description: 小嘴 · 实时解说 —— DeepSeek Harness 输入框下方的语音解说插件
plugins.readme_text:
# 小嘴 · 实时解说（live-narrator）

> 住在输入框下面的小小解说员：AI 一边干活，它一边用语音把正在发生的事讲给你听。

![小嘴 · 实时解说](docs/demo.png)

这是一个 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）** 的 Web 客户端插件。它不做任何模型调用——只是把 agent 正在做的事（思考、调用工具、读文件、跑命令）翻译成一句人话，用浏览器自带的语音合成念出来。

## 它做什么

- **一条常驻的小横条**，贴在对话输入框正下方，不占对话区
- **开关**：点一下就开/关，状态记在 localStorage，刷新后还在
- **实时解说**：agent 每进入一个新动作，就把这件事写成一句短话念出来（不是把整个回答读一遍）
- **音色可选**：下拉里列出系统可用的语音，选完会念一句示例
- **可视化波形**：正在说话时，头像的嘴会动，右侧有跳动的电平
- **零后端**：没有服务端、没有网络请求、没有 API key

## 安装

### 本地链接安装（开发用）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:C:\path\to\live-narrator
```

然后重启一次 DSH（bundle 层要重启才组装）。

### 手动挂载

1. 把整个目录放到任意位置
2. 在 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里加入包名
3. 用 `link:` 依赖指向本地目录

> ⚠️ 包名现在是 `@local/live-narrator`，属于「本机私有链接」的写法。如果你想发到 npm 或让别人直接 `dsh plugin add`，把 `package.json` 的 `name` 改成 `dsh-live-narrator`（或你喜欢的名字）再发。

## 配置

插件在浏览器侧自己存两个键：

| 键 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `dsh.live-narrator.enabled` | 是否开启解说（`1` / `0`） |
| `dsh.live-narrator.voice` | 选中的语音 URI，空 = 系统默认 |

没有 host 侧配置项，`index.js` 的 `apply()` 是空的——所有逻辑都在 `client.js` 里。

## 目录结构

```
live-narrator/
├── index.js           # Host 半边（空实现，只为满足 bundle 结构）
├── client.js          # 全部逻辑：渲染、状态机、语音合成
├── cordis.patch.yml   # bundle patch：把自己插进 profile 的配置树
├── locale/
│   ├── zh.json        # 中文文案
│   └── en.json
├── icon.svg           # 插件图标
└── package.json
```

## 开发

`client.js` 是浏览器侧模块，通过 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 注册。改完后如果 `pnpm run dev:web` 在跑，客户端模块会热加载；否则刷新页面。

## License

MIT。见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: ⚡ DSH 模型补齐助手：解决添加新渠道后还要把几十个模型一个个手动点开调上下文（1M）、勾多模态发图、配思考强度档位（low/high/max）的繁琐痛点，新增模型保存即自动搞定！
plugins.readme_text:
# ⚡ DSH 模型补齐助手（dsh-model-auto-enricher）

**告别在 DSH 里加完模型渠道后，还要把几十个模型一个个手动点开调上下文、勾图片、配思考强度的繁琐苦力活！**

---

## 😫 为什么做这个插件？（真实痛点）

在 DSH 里每添加一个新的中转站或第三方 API 渠道，里面往往有十几个甚至几十个模型。
但是在 DSH 默认设置界面里，拉取或添加完模型后，**每一个模型都得你自己手动点开去调**：
- 要一个个手填 **上下文窗口**（默认是空的，或者被限制在 128k / 200k，不改很快就会爆上下文）；
- 要一个个手填 **最大输出 Token**（默认是空的）；
- 要一个个手动勾选 **「图片」多模态开关**（默认只勾了纯文本，不勾根本发不了截图）；
- 要一个个手动打开 **「推理等级」开关** 并添加 `max` 档位（默认没开，开了也只有 `low / medium / high`，没有最高 `max` 档）。

**十几个模型一个个点开改下来，又麻烦又累；以后每次往渠道里新加一两个模型，还得再重复折腾一遍！**

装上 **「DSH 模型补齐助手」** 后：
👉 **你只需要在设置里把渠道和模型加进去、点一下保存，剩下的调上下文（100 万）、开多模态发图、配思考强度档位（`low / high / max`）全部由插件在后台自动帮你一次性搞定！**

---

## 🛠️ 具体帮你省掉哪些手动操作？

| 你以前要手动挨个调的项 | DSH 默认刚加进来时 | 装上本插件后（全自动） |
|---|---|---|
| **1. 调上下文容量** | 空白未填，或被截断在 `128k` / `200k` / `256k` | 自动全部拉满到 **100 万长上下文（`1,000,000`）** |
| **2. 调最大输出** | 空白未填 | 自动按系列补齐 **`64,000` / `128,000`** 最大输出 |
| **3. 调多模态（发图）** | 默认只勾了「文本」，聊天框发不了图 | 自动为所有模型勾选 **「文本 + 图片」（`[text, image]`）** |
| **4. 调思考强度档位** | 默认关闭，或手动打开后缺少 `max` 档 | 自动配齐 **`{ low, high, max }` 思考强度档位**（并保留已有自定义档位） |

---

## ✨ 核心亮点（v2.0 中文友好 · 全自动版）

1. **⚡ 添加新模型保存即自动生效（无需手动点按钮、无需重启 DSH）**
   - 插件在后台自动监听 DSH 的模型设置保存事件。
   - 只要你在 **「设置 → 模型」** 里添加了新模型并点击「应用」，插件会在 **0.6 秒内自动在后台帮你把百万上下文、64k+ 最大输出、发图支持、思考档位全部补齐**，并立即热重载生效！
2. **🧠 认识所有新模型（内置全系列规则 + 通用新模型兜底）**
   - 不仅完整识别 **GPT-4o / GPT-5 / GPT-6 / o1~o9 / Codex**、**Claude 4 / 4.5 / 4.6 / 5 / 5.5+ (Opus / Sonnet)**、**Gemini 2.5 / 3 / 3.5 / 4**、**DeepSeek V3 / V4 / V4.1 / R1 / R2**、**GLM 5 / 5.2 / 5.3 / Z1**、**Kimi K2.6 / K2.7 / K2.8 / K3**、**腾讯混元 Hy3 / Hy4**、**MiniMax / Step / Qwen / Grok / 豆包 / Llama / Mistral** 等全系模型；
   - **哪怕是你以后新加的、名字从来没见过的全新模型或内部代号模型**（如 `space-bunny`、`argon`、`astra`、`sol` 等），也会自动触发**「通用新模型规则」**，默认按顶配规格（`1M 上下文 + 64k 最大输出 + 支持发图 + low/high/max 思考档位`）一步到位补齐！
3. **🛡️ 100% 安全，只升不降，写前自动备份**
   - **只升不降**：如果你某个模型已经设了更大的上下文或更大的输出（如 `128000`），绝不会给你改小；已有的自定义思考档位（如 `off`、`medium`、`xhigh`）一律原样保留。
   - **自动备份**：每次修改配置文件前，都会自动在同目录生成带时间戳的备份文件（`cordis.patch.yml.bak-auto-enrich-YYYYMMDD-HHmmss`）。
   - **严格幂等**：所有模型已经是最佳状态时，不会改动任何字节，也不会产生多余备份。
4. **🖥️ 内置可视化管理面板（设置 → 模型补齐助手）**
   - 在 DSH 设置页左侧导航栏新增 **「模型补齐助手」** 面板，随时查看所有渠道与模型的健康状态、识别系列标签、上下文容量、多模态与思考档位明细，也支持手动一键补齐。

---

## 📦 一键安装

### 方式一：在 DSH 插件市场（dshmarket）中安装
打开 DSH **设置 → 插件市场**，搜索 **`dsh-model-auto-enricher`** 或 **模型补齐助手**，点击**安装**即可。

### 方式二：命令行一键安装

桌面版（`desktop` profile）：
```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add 66rapper/dsh-model-auto-enricher
```

网页版（`web` profile）：
```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 66rapper/dsh-model-auto-enricher
```

---

## 📊 内置智能补齐规则表（v2.0）

| 模型系列 | 自动识别关键词 | 补齐上下文 (`contextWindow`) | 补齐最大输出 (`maxTokens`) | 模态支持 (`input`) | 思考强度档位 (`reasoningEfforts`) |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|---|
| **Gemini 系列** | `gemini / gemma` | `1,000,000` (1M) | `64,000` | `[text, image]` | 除纯 `lite` / `image` 生图小模型外全系开启 |
| **Claude 系列** | `claude` | `1,000,000` (老款 Claude 2/3 为 `200,000`) | `64,000` | `[text, image]` | `4.5+ / 5+ / opus / sonnet / thinking / high` 全系开启 |
| **DeepSeek 系列** | `deepseek` | `1,000,000` (1M) | `128,000` | `[text, image]` | `v4 / v5 / r1 / r2 / pro / flash / thinking` 全系开启 |
| **GLM 智谱系列** | `glm / chatglm` | `1,000,000` (1M) | `flash` `128,000`；其余 `64,000` | `[text, image]` | `5.2 / 5.3 / 6 / z1 / flash / high` 开启 |
| **Kimi 系列** | `kimi / moonshot` | `k2.6 / k2.7` 为 `256,000`；其余 `1,000,000` | `k2.8 / k3+` 为 `64,000`；其余 `32,000` | `[text, image]` | `k2.8 / k3 / k4 / preview` 开启 |
| **GPT 系列** | `gpt-* / chatgpt / o1~o9 / codex` | `1,000,000` (1M) | `64,000` | `[text, image]` | `gpt-5 / 6 / 7+ / o1~o9 / codex / astra / sol` 开启 |
| **腾讯混元系列** | `hy3 / hy4 / hunyuan` | `hy3` 为 `192,000`；`hy4+` 为 `1,000,000` | `64,000` | `[text, image]` | `hy3 / hy4+ / preview / thinking` 开启 |
| **主流大模型系列** | `minimax / step / qwen / grok / doubao / llama / mistral` | `1,000,000` (1M) | `64,000` | `[text, image]` | `step-5+ / grok-3+ / qwen-3+ / m3+ / thinking` 开启 |
| **🌟 通用新模型规则** | **任何未见过的全新模型 / 内部代号模型（自动兜底）** | **`1,000,000` (1M)** | **`64,000`** | **`[text, image]`** | **默认开启 `{ low, high, max }`** |
| **GPT 开源版** | `gpt-oss` | `128,000` | `64,000` | `[text]`（纯文本） | 不开启 |
| **残缺档位自动补全** | 任何已开启部分思考档位的模型 | 保持原值或拉升 | 保持原值或拉升 | 保持或补齐图片 | 自动补齐缺失的 `{ low, high, max }`，保留原有档位 |

---
